hexagrams.judgmentEn: Qian — Great from the very beginning, flourishing, and a benefit to those who hold to what is right.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven above heaven: the turning of the heavens is strong and never stops. The wise person therefore trains themselves to be strong and keeps striving without tiring.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Six yang lines make pure creative energy, like heaven that moves without rest and gives birth to all things. This is a time of energy and wide-open chances, but success depends on honesty and a sense of timing. The six lines tell the growth of a dragon: hiding, appearing, striving, testing a leap, soaring, and finally climbing so high that regret follows. Use your strength with a sense of the right moment. Do not rush before the time has come, and do not grow proud at the peak.
linesEn: The dragon lies hidden in the deep. Do not act yet. The strength is still being nurtured, so stay quiet, gather your power and wait for the moment.
The dragon appears in the field. It is favorable to meet a great person. Your ability is starting to show. A good time to seek a guide or supporter.
All day the wise person keeps striving, and at night stays alert as if in danger. There is peril but no fault. You are at a turning point, and diligence and care will carry you through.
Some leap up, some remain in the depths. No fault. You are choosing between rising and waiting. Testing the ground carefully is never a mistake.
The dragon flies in the sky. It is favorable to meet a great person. You have reached the place where your power blooms fully. Use this success to work with people of good character.
The dragon soars too high and will have regret. Going all the way to the end without knowing when to retreat, pride brings disappointment.
hexagrams.allLinesEn: When all six lines change at once (using the nines): a flock of dragons is seen, none of them taking the lead. Good fortune. Strong power that does not grab for leadership brings harmony and good fortune.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Heaven never stops moving. In what area will you take a step today, even a small one?

yearMessageEn.overview: Heaven moves without pause. This year suits starting things and leading with steady effort. Great energy needs the right timing: know when to push and when to rest.
yearMessageEn.work: You may begin what you set out to do. Watch the timing and do not burn out.
yearMessageEn.love: Show sincerity steadily. Do not let strength turn into feeling superior.
yearMessageEn.money: Plan long term with steady effort, and beware of too much confidence.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you have strength and good timing all year.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Kun — Great and flourishing, favoring the steadiness of a mare. When the wise person sets out, leading will lead them astray, while following will find a guide. In the southwest friends are gained; in the northeast friends are lost. Staying calm and steady in what is right brings good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Earth above earth: the nature of the land is to be humble and bear things up. The wise person therefore builds up deep, thick virtue in order to carry all things.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Six yin lines are the power of receiving and nourishing, like the land that holds up everything without choosing. This is not a time to start things or take the lead, but to support, follow the right course, and work patiently and quietly. Success comes from gentleness that stays steady, not from grabbing position. Watch for small signs of larger things to come, and do not let softness turn into a contest for power with the strong side.
linesEn: Stepping on frost, thick ice is soon to come. Small signs show a larger trend. Notice them and prepare early.
Straight, upright and great. Without training, nothing fails to benefit. Follow your own honest nature and things will settle into place.

Keeping one's excellence within, one can hold firm. Perhaps serving the king's work, not claiming the achievement, yet seeing it through. Hide your ability, work for the common good without seeking honor, and the ending will be good.
Tie the mouth of the bag. No fault, and no praise. For now, guard your words, be careful, and do not reveal too much.
A yellow skirt-cloth. Great good fortune. Goodness held humbly in the middle position brings great fortune.
Dragons fight in the field, their blood dark and yellow. When softness tries to contend with strength to the very end, a clash follows in which both sides are hurt.
hexagrams.allLinesEn: When all six lines change (using the sixes): it benefits lasting steadiness in what is right. Gentleness held firmly for a long time slowly turns into solid stability.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: The earth holds up all things without choosing. Today, try listening more than speaking.

yearMessageEn.overview: The earth holds everything quietly. This year is about gentleness, patience and being a base for others. Not rushing to the front may lead you to a more suitable path.
yearMessageEn.work: Be a supporter people can trust. Listening first keeps work smooth.
yearMessageEn.love: Gentleness and listening make a relationship steadier, slowly.
yearMessageEn.money: Build up steadily. Consistency matters more than hurry.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your heart be wide and steady like the earth.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Zhun — Great and flourishing, favoring what is right. Do not rush forward yet. It is favorable to appoint helpers or lay a foundation.
hexagrams.imageEn: Clouds above thunder: the first hardship of beginnings. The wise person therefore puts things in order, like a weaver sorting out threads.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Picture a seedling pushing up through the soil, or a storm where rain clouds and thunder churn. Starting something new is confusing and gets stuck, yet inside it is full of life. The advice is not to rush ahead alone. Stop, organize, build a structure, and find helpers you can trust. This tangle will ease when the time is ripe.
linesEn: Hesitating and circling. It is favorable to stay firm in what is right, and favorable to appoint helpers. When a start is stuck, do not force it. Hold to your principles and build allies.

Stuck and winding, the rider's horses turn back. The visitor is no robber but a suitor. The young woman stays firm and does not accept the betrothal; after ten years she does. Help that is offered may come at the wrong time. Waiting honestly, however long, brings the right thing.

Chasing deer without a guide, one wanders into the middle of the forest. The wise person sees the sign and lets go; pressing on brings shame. Do not chase goals in what you do not truly know. Knowing when to stop is wisdom.
The rider's horses turn back. Go and ask for the union. Going brings good fortune; nothing fails to benefit. You cannot succeed alone, but if you are willing to approach partners, all goes well.

Rich provision is held back. In small matters, staying firm brings good fortune; in big matters, staying firm brings misfortune. Resources or influence are not yet flowing. Small things can be done step by step, but do not force big ones.
The rider's horses turn back, and bloody tears flow. Hardship has reached its limit and despair. Know that this suffering will not last if you are willing to change your attitude.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A seedling breaks through the soil with difficulty. The mess of beginnings does not mean the path is wrong.

yearMessageEn.overview: A seedling must struggle up through the soil. This year may begin in confusion, but that is the nature of new things. Lay foundations step by step and do not hesitate to ask for help.
yearMessageEn.work: New work may stick. Build the foundation slowly and find helpers you trust.
yearMessageEn.love: A new relationship needs time. Be patient and do not jump to conclusions.
yearMessageEn.money: Sort out income and spending clearly first. Small steady steps beat big ones.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May every beginning of yours take strong root.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Meng — Flourishing. I do not go looking for the untaught child; the untaught child comes looking for me. The first casting gives an answer. To ask a second or third time is disrespect, and disrespect gets no answer. It favors what is right.
hexagrams.imageEn: A spring bubbles out at the foot of a mountain: youth without experience. The wise person therefore acts decisively and nurtures virtue.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Like a spring that has just come out of the mountain and does not yet know where to flow, this is a state of lacking knowledge or experience. The way out is to learn with sincerity and humility. The learner must be the one to seek the teacher, and once an answer comes, listen with care and do not ask over and over just because the answer is unwelcome. The teacher should be patient, disciplined, and kind in due measure.
linesEn: Opening up ignorance. It is favorable to use punishment as an example and to remove the shackles. If strictness goes on and on, there will be shame. Learning begins with discipline, but too harsh a discipline turns into chains.
Embracing the ignorant with patience: good fortune. Taking a wife: good fortune. The son can manage the household. Generosity toward those with less brings harmony and lets duties be passed on.
Do not take this woman. Seeing a man of wealth, she loses herself. Nothing is favorable. Do not trust someone swayed by outside gain, and do not become that person yourself.
Trapped in ignorance: shame. Shutting yourself away from those who know and from the truth, you stay sunk in not knowing.
A child still untaught: good fortune. A mind that is open, innocent and ready to learn receives good guidance.
Striking at ignorance. It is not favorable to act as a robber, but favorable to guard against robbers. Punishing wrongs should aim to protect, not to hurt in anger.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Those who admit they do not yet know have opened the door to learning. What do you want to know today?

yearMessageEn.overview: Whoever admits not knowing has opened the door to learning. This year suits sincere questions, finding a good teacher, and studying with an open mind, without hurrying for ready-made answers.
yearMessageEn.work: Open your mind to new things, ask when unsure, and listen to the experienced.
yearMessageEn.love: Not understanding each other is solved by asking and listening sincerely.
yearMessageEn.money: Understand money matters before you decide. Do not rely on feelings alone.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you stay curious and find a good teacher.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Xu — With sincerity, it will be bright and flourishing. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. It is favorable to cross the great river.
hexagrams.imageEn: Clouds rise to the sky: waiting for rain. The wise person therefore eats, drinks and rests in good cheer.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Clouds hang in the sky but the rain has not fallen. Danger lies ahead like water blocking the way, while inside there is strong energy. This is a time for waiting with confidence, not anxiously. Nourish body and mind to be ready, hold to sincerity, and when the time comes you will cross the great obstacle. Charging in before the time only invites trouble.
linesEn: Waiting in the outskirts. It is favorable to keep steadiness. No fault. Danger is still far away. Live normally and steadily, and do not panic.
Waiting on the sandbank. A little gossip, but in the end good fortune. Nearer the problem now, there is talk, but if you stay calm it will pass well.
Waiting in the mud, drawing robbers to come. You have stepped too close to danger and become vulnerable. Take extra care.
Waiting amid bloodshed. Climb out of the hole. You are in the midst of danger. Be still and calm, go along with the situation, and find a way to withdraw.
Waiting amid wine and food. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. In the calm during the wait, rest and rebuild your strength, but do not be careless.

Entering the pit, three guests come unasked. Treat them with respect, and in the end there is good fortune. When waiting reaches its end, something unexpected may come. If you receive it openly and with honor, it turns into help.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Clouds gather before the rain. Waiting calmly is also a way of preparing.

yearMessageEn.overview: Clouds gather before rain. This year, calm waiting is preparation. Look after yourself, trust the timing that is coming, and act when the moment arrives.
yearMessageEn.work: Wait for the moment with awareness, and prepare as well as you can meanwhile.
yearMessageEn.love: A good relationship needs no hurry. Let time and trust grow slowly.
yearMessageEn.money: Be patient and unhurried. Keep what you have steady while you wait.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your patience bear flowers and fruit.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Song — Though sincere, you are obstructed. Be on guard. Stopping halfway brings good fortune; pushing on to the end is dangerous. It is favorable to meet a great person; not favorable to cross the great river.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven and water move in opposite directions: conflict. The wise person therefore plans carefully from the very start of any undertaking.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Heaven rises high and water flows low; the two part ways. This is the picture of conflict from intentions that do not match. Even if you are partly in the right, fighting to the end brings only damage. The advice is to be willing to stop halfway, find a neutral elder to help decide, and not begin a large project now. Best of all is to prevent conflict from the start by agreeing things clearly.
linesEn: Not dragging the matter out. A little gossip, but in the end good fortune. Stop the conflict while it is small. You may lose some face but it ends well.
Unable to win the case, he goes back and hides. The three hundred households of his town are spared trouble. Knowing you cannot win and stepping back protects both yourself and those around you.

Living on old merit and goodness, holding firm despite danger, in the end good fortune. Perhaps serving the king's work, not claiming the achievement. Be content with what is rightfully yours, do not grab more, and do not show off.
Unable to win the case, he returns and accepts his fate, turning toward calm steadiness: good fortune. Give up the thought of winning, turn back to what is right, and you will find peace.
Judging the dispute: great good fortune. A fair judge is present and the conflict is settled justly.
Perhaps one is granted a ceremonial belt, but within a single day it is taken away three times. A victory won by fighting does not last, and keeps bringing enmity back.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Before arguing to win, ask yourself what you really want.

yearMessageEn.overview: Conflict often comes from wanting to win more than wanting to solve the problem. This year, hold back, think before starting, and make room for a mediator. Every win may cost something more important.
yearMessageEn.work: Watch for disputes. Negotiate with reason and stop before conflict grows.
yearMessageEn.love: Before arguing to win, ask what you truly want, then speak plainly.
yearMessageEn.money: Take care with contracts and agreements. Always put them clearly in writing.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your new year be calm and free of conflict.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Shi — Holding to what is right, with a senior and respected leader: good fortune, no fault.
hexagrams.imageEn: Within the earth there is water: an army. The wise person therefore embraces the people and nurtures the masses.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Water hidden underground is like the strength that lies among the people. This situation calls for the strength of a group united under discipline and a just aim. Success depends on a leader who is experienced and trusted, not one who merely wants power. Organize clearly, give tasks to the right people, and take care that several people do not give overlapping orders.
linesEn: The army sets out with order. Without order, even what looks good ends in misfortune. Whatever you begin needs clear rules, or it will fail.
In the midst of the army: good fortune, no fault. The king gives orders three times. A leader who stays close to the group and is trusted from above will succeed.
The army may have to carry corpses home: misfortune. Leadership by someone unable, or by several people fighting over command, brings loss.
The army withdraws to camp: no fault. When circumstances are against you, an orderly retreat is wisdom, not defeat.

There is game in the field. It is favorable to call for its capture. No fault. Let the elder son lead the army; if the younger son leads, corpses will be carried home. Even holding firm, there is danger. You may protect yourself when attacked, but authority must be given to one suitable person only.

The great ruler gives orders, founding states and establishing families. Do not employ petty people. When the task is done, reward those who deserve it, but do not hand governing power to people without virtue.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: As water gathers underground, disciplined strength stays quiet. What can you put in order today?

yearMessageEn.overview: As water collects underground, disciplined strength stays calm. This year suits organizing, a rightful leader, and discipline for you and your team, without excess authority.
yearMessageEn.work: Organize your team and plans. Discipline and fairness are your key strengths.
yearMessageEn.love: Care responsibly, but do not use strictness to control a loved one.
yearMessageEn.money: Set clear financial discipline with a budget and rules of your own.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you have firm discipline and good companions.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Bi — Good fortune. Examine your own heart once more: is it great, lasting and upright? Then there is no fault. Those not yet at ease will come to you; one who arrives too late meets misfortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Water on the earth: close and tightly joined. The kings of old therefore established the many states and made friendly ties with the lords.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Water seeping over the land clings close with no gaps, a picture of hearts joining around one center. This is a good time to join a group or build good relationships, but first look into whether you are sincere and steady enough. If you are the center, welcome others with a wide heart. If you are the one choosing, choose people worth committing to, and do not hesitate so long that the chance is lost.
linesEn: Being sincere in drawing close: no fault. Sincerity brimming like a full jar, in the end other good fortune comes. A relationship that starts in sincerity brings unexpected good things.
Closeness comes from within. Holding firm brings good fortune. Bind yourself with a true heart without losing yourself; this is not flattery for gain.
Drawing close to the wrong people. Keeping the wrong company brings damage. Step back politely.
Drawing close to one outside. Holding firm brings good fortune. It is right to show openly your loyalty to a person of virtue above you.

Open closeness. The king hunts with three sides surrounded, letting the game ahead escape. The townspeople are not alarmed. Good fortune. A good leader compels no one: whoever wants to come may come, whoever wants to go is let go, and so people trust such a leader.
Drawing close without a head: misfortune. A gathering with no beginning or anchor, or joining when it is too late, has no good result.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Water rests naturally against the earth. Who would you like to be closer to today?

yearMessageEn.overview: Water rests naturally against the earth. This year, relationships and joining hearts are central. Choose people you trust, approach sincerely, and do not wait so long that you miss the chance.
yearMessageEn.work: Work with the right people and build a team sincerely, without long hesitation.
yearMessageEn.love: Open your heart to stay close to those you love. Bonds come from steady care.
yearMessageEn.money: Helping each other among trusted people brings more stability.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be warmed by friends and loved ones all year.

hexagrams.meaningEn: Small restraint, gathering bit by bit
hexagrams.judgmentEn: Xiao Chu — Flourishing. Dense clouds but no rain yet, drifting from our western outskirts.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind blows across the sky: a slight restraint. The wise person therefore refines the beauty of their virtue and cultured manner.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: A single yin line holds back the five yang lines, like a soft wind passing over the sky that cannot yet gather clouds into rain. What you wish for is near but the time has not come. The obstacle is small yet cannot be pushed aside by force. Use gentleness, patience and attention to detail in developing yourself. Gather little by little, and the rain will fall in its own time.
linesEn: Returning to your own way, what fault could there be? Good fortune. When held back, going back to your own basic course is the right path.
Drawn back along the way: good fortune. Turn back together with companions of the same mind; do not push ahead alone.
The spokes come off the cart; husband and wife turn away from each other. Pushing ahead while being restrained causes a break in the relationship.
With sincerity, bloodshed is avoided and fear departs. No fault. Sincerity eases danger and tension.
Sincerity that binds closely, sharing wealth with the neighbors. Honesty that is shared lets everyone prosper together.

The rain has fallen; rest now. Virtue is stored up to a full load, but a woman who holds firm is still in danger. The moon is nearly full. If the wise person sets out, there will be misfortune. The goal is reached. Be content and stop; do not push further than is right.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Thick clouds, no rain yet. Gather bit by bit for now. Small things done today still matter.

yearMessageEn.overview: Thick clouds but no rain yet. This year is for gathering little by little. Small, gentle efforts repeated steadily will slowly add up to great strength when the time comes.
yearMessageEn.work: Big work may still stall. Build skills and small achievements for now.
yearMessageEn.love: Care for small things daily. A little gentleness has more power than you think.
yearMessageEn.money: Save little by little, steadily. Do not hurry for a big sum.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May the small things you do slowly grow into good.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Lu — Treading on the tiger's tail, but the tiger does not bite. Flourishing.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven above, lake below: walking with order. The wise person therefore tells high from low clearly and steadies the hearts of the people.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The gentle lake lies below the strong heaven, like a weak person who must walk behind the powerful, as if treading on a tiger's tail. This situation is risky but safe if you act with good manners, humility and knowledge of your place. Sincere politeness means even a fierce one does not harm us. Beware of rating yourself too high.
linesEn: Walking simply. Setting out brings no fault. Follow your own way purely, without ambition beyond your size, and there will be no trouble.
Walking on a smooth, level road. A recluse holding firm: good fortune. A calm mind that grasps at nothing walks the middle path steadily.

A one-eyed man thinks he can see; a lame man thinks he can walk. Treading on the tiger's tail, the tiger bites: misfortune. A warrior acts as a king. Overrating yourself and charging into danger brings misfortune.
Treading on the tiger's tail, with deep fear and caution. In the end good fortune. You are in a dangerous situation, but care brings you through.
Walking with resolve. Holding firm, but there is danger. You can decide firmly, but know that too much confidence brings risk.
Look back on your steps and examine the omens. If it comes full circle, great good fortune. Looking back on past actions, if they are complete and good, good results follow.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Every step on the path shows who we are. Today, try stepping with awareness and courtesy.

yearMessageEn.overview: Every step on the path shows who we are. This year stresses courteous conduct and knowing your place. Even when walking near something risky, care will see you through.
yearMessageEn.work: Courtesy opens the way for you. Know what should and should not be done.
yearMessageEn.love: Speak and behave with respect. Attention to detail makes love last.
yearMessageEn.money: Be careful before deciding. Check the details every time.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May every step of yours be steady and graceful.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Tai — The small go away, the great arrive. Good fortune. Flourishing.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven and earth join: peace. The ruler therefore shapes and completes the way of heaven and earth, and supports what suits them, in order to help the people.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Earth is above, heaven is below. The energy of heaven rises and that of earth sinks, so the two meet and nourish each other. This is an age of harmony: communication flows, elders and juniors understand each other, good things grow and bad things withdraw. Use this time to build what lasts and share it with others. But remember that everything turns in cycles, and prosperity needs vigilance.
linesEn: Pulling up couch grass, the roots come up together in a clump. Setting out brings good fortune. Good people draw good people along. A good time to act with like-minded people.

Embracing even the neglected, bold enough to wade the river, not forgetting those far away, not favoring one's own clique, so one fits the middle path. Generous, brave, far-sighted and free of cliques.

No plain without a slope, no going without a return. Holding firm in hardship, no fault. Do not worry; sincerity brings good fortune. Prosperity will change one day. Keep your honesty and you will not lack.

Fluttering down, not relying on wealth but on neighbors, sincere with one another without needing warning. Those above lower themselves to those below with a true heart, and cooperation arises naturally.
King Di Yi marries off his daughter. There is blessing. Great good fortune. A person of high standing lowers themselves to create harmony, bringing real happiness.

The city wall collapses into the moat. Do not use the army. Give orders only within your own town. Even holding firm, there is shame. Prosperity has reached its end. Do not resist by force; look after what is near and accept the change.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Heaven and earth are connected. Smooth times are a good time to care for relationships.

yearMessageEn.overview: Heaven and earth are connected. This year, harmony and communication open the way for good things. But smooth times are when to tend your foundation and stay alert.
yearMessageEn.work: Communication is smooth. Build cooperation now, but do not get complacent.
yearMessageEn.love: The relationship is in harmony. Care for each other and speak clearly.
yearMessageEn.money: Timing is good, but keep some in reserve. Prudence keeps good times lasting.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your new year be peaceful, harmonious and prosperous.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Pi — This blockage comes from the wrong people. It does not favor the steadfastness of the wise person. The great go away, the small arrive.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven and earth do not join: stagnation. The wise person therefore keeps virtue simply hidden to avoid harm, and does not accept honor through wealth and rank.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Heaven is above and rises higher; earth is below and sinks lower. The two part and do not reach each other. This is an age when communication is cut off, small people hold power and good people are pushed aside. What you do may not bear fruit. In such times do not scramble for position or gain. Stay humble, keep your heart pure, and wait for the day heaven and earth join again, because stagnation cannot last forever.
linesEn: Pulling up couch grass, the roots come up together in a clump. Holding firm brings good fortune. Flourishing. In dark times, good people should withdraw together and keep their principles together.

Putting up with it and flattering. The small gain; the great person accepts the blockage, and it becomes flourishing. Ordinary people may profit by going along, but a person of virtue should accept hardship rather than abandon principle.
Bearing disgrace. Someone who gained position wrongly begins to feel ashamed of themselves.
There is a command from above. No fault. Companions all receive blessing. As circumstances start to change, following what is right benefits both oneself and the group.

The blockage stops. Good fortune for the great person. Remember: it may be lost, it may be lost. Then tie yourself to a firm mulberry clump. The dark age begins to ease, but do not be careless. Constant watchfulness keeps you secure.
The blockage is overturned. First blockage, then joy. When darkness reaches its limit it turns over, and happiness is about to come.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Some days the door is closed. Stepping back calmly to regroup is not defeat.

yearMessageEn.overview: At times the door is shut. This year may feel stalled or misunderstood. Stepping back calmly and keeping your worth is not defeat, but waiting for heaven to open again.
yearMessageEn.work: Work may not progress as hoped. Step back to regroup and wait for a change.
yearMessageEn.love: If you feel apart, do not force it. Give time and stay yourself.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend only what is necessary and keep quiet until things clear.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you stay calm and soon see a new door open.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Tong Ren — Joining hearts with people in the open field. Flourishing. It is favorable to cross the great river, and favors the steadfastness of the wise person.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven and fire: joining hearts with people. The wise person therefore sorts people into groups and tells things apart.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Fire flares up toward heaven; both aim the same way. It is the picture of people joined by a shared ideal. True cooperation must be open like a wide field, not limited to a clique, relatives or private gain. United transparently, people can get through big tasks. But a good group also knows how to tell differences apart, not blend everything into sameness.
linesEn: Joining with people at the gate. No fault. Start the relationship openly from the first step, with no personal obligations yet.
Joining only within one's own clan: shame. Binding yourself to a narrow circle or cliques loses legitimacy.
Hiding troops in the thick grass, climbing a high mound; for three years unable to rise. Suspicion and hidden intent stop cooperation from forming. The longer you wait, the fewer chances there are.
Climbing the wall but not attacking: good fortune. You thought of using force but held back in time, realizing it was not right. Changing your mind brings good fortune.
The people joined in heart first weep, later laugh. The great army wins and they meet. Those whose hearts match but who were kept apart will meet joyfully after hardship.
Joining with people in the outskirts. No regret. A bond that is far off, though not complete, leaves nothing to regret.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: An open heart turns strangers into friends. Today, try finding common ground with someone.

yearMessageEn.overview: An open heart turns strangers into friends. This year cooperation and shared aims are your strength. Stop choosing sides and you may find unexpected companions.
yearMessageEn.work: Cooperate with many kinds of people toward one goal. Avoid closed circles.
yearMessageEn.love: Find common ground with your loved one. Openness brings you closer.
yearMessageEn.money: Sharing and cooperating openly bring stability.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you find true friends and good companions.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Da You — Great and flourishing.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire above heaven: great wealth. The wise person therefore restrains evil, promotes good, follows heaven and accepts its good decree.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The sun shines brightly high in the sky and shows everything clearly. A single yin line sits in the leader's place and is supported by the five yang lines. It is an age of abundance and success, but true wealth must come with humility and rightness. Use what you have to promote good and to share, not to boast or take advantage.
linesEn: Having no dealings with what is harmful, so no fault. Keep the hardship in mind always and there will be no fault. Wealth has just begun and there is no problem, but remember difficulty always.
A big cart carries the load. There is somewhere to go. No fault. You have the ability and resources to bear a big task. Go ahead with the work.
A lord presents an offering to the Son of Heaven; a small person cannot do this. Wealth should be offered for the common good; a narrow-minded person will hold it as their own.
Not boasting of one's greatness. No fault. Though having much, you do not overpower others. Knowing to be humble, you stay safe.
Sincerity that connects people, together with dignity that inspires awe: good fortune. A sincere and dignified leader receives both love and respect.
Protected by heaven: good fortune. Nothing fails to benefit. One who is complete in goodness and honors heaven receives full blessing.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: When you have much, be more humble. What do you feel grateful for today?

yearMessageEn.overview: When you have much, be more humble. This year you may find abundance in many areas. Keep the light in your heart, be grateful, and use wealth in ways that promote good.
yearMessageEn.work: Your results stand out more. Stay humble and open chances for others too.
yearMessageEn.love: Thank those at your side. Warmth matters more than gifts.
yearMessageEn.money: You may be steadier, but share and do not show off what you have.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be rich in kindness and gratitude.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Qian — Flourishing. The wise person has a complete ending.
hexagrams.imageEn: A mountain within the earth: humility. The wise person therefore takes from what is too much to add to what is too little, weighs things, and shares fairly.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: A great tall mountain hides beneath the earth, a picture of someone able who does not show off. Humility is the one virtue for which every line of this hexagram brings good fortune, because heaven, earth, people and spirits all lessen what overflows and fill what is lacking. Work without seeking praise, balance yourself with others, and success will come to last.
linesEn: The wise person who is humble and humble again can cross the great river. Good fortune. Deep humility lets you pass even a hard task.
Humility that becomes known. Holding firm brings good fortune. True humility comes from the heart so that others sense it themselves.
The wise person who works hard yet stays humble has a good ending: good fortune. You achieve much without boasting, so people accept you sincerely.
Nothing fails to benefit. Spread humility outward. Humility should show in actions in every area, not only in words.

Not relying on wealth but on neighbors. It is favorable to use force against those who do not submit. Nothing fails to benefit. Humility is not weakness. Sometimes one must be decisive toward those who break the peace.
Humility that becomes known. It is favorable to send the army to subdue one's own towns and state. Use that accepted humility to put things near you in order and correct your own faults.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: The mountain hides under the earth. True humility does not need announcing.

yearMessageEn.overview: A mountain hides beneath the earth. True humility needs no announcing. This year, moderation, consistency and sharing will lead you to a good ending, without grabbing or hurrying.
yearMessageEn.work: Work steadily without boasting. Your results will speak for you.
yearMessageEn.love: Humility and respect keep love warm and lasting.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend in moderation, within your means, and share as you can.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be calm, humble and complete in the end.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Yu — It is favorable to appoint helpers and send the army out.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder bursts out of the earth with a roar: delight. The kings of old therefore made music to honor virtue, offered it grandly to the gods above, and dedicated it to their ancestors.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The first thunder of spring bursts from the ground and wakes all things. It is a picture of eager energy that makes people ready to move together. This is a good time to rally people, form a team and begin work, because people are ready to follow. But delight must rest on a steady base and be in tune with nature. If it turns into indulgence, happiness turns into regret.
linesEn: Delight that is announced loudly: misfortune. Boasting of your joy or advantage invites trouble.
Firm as a rock, not waiting for the day to end. Holding firm brings good fortune. You are not drawn into fun, and on seeing the signs you can decide at once.
Looking up to others for delight brings regret; hesitating too long also brings regret. Depending on the powerful for happiness, or hesitating to change, both bring regret.
The source of delight. Great gains. Do not doubt. Friends gather as a hairpin gathers hair. You are the center that sparks people. If sincere and not hesitating, people will join you.
Chronic illness, yet holding firm. Lasting long, not dying. Though pressed and not free, if you hold yourself up you will not collapse.
Lost in the intoxication of delight. If what has been done can be changed, no fault. Stuck in infatuation, but it is not too late if you wake up and turn back.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Delight has the power to draw people in. What makes you want to move today?

yearMessageEn.overview: Delight draws people in. This year eagerness and inspiration will carry you forward, but do not get carried away and forget to prepare. Let happiness be a drive with principles.
yearMessageEn.work: Use enthusiasm to motivate the team, but have a plan, not just momentum.
yearMessageEn.love: Joy brings hearts close. Have fun together, but do not forget to be sincere.
yearMessageEn.money: Some fun spending is fine, but keep discipline. Do not follow moods.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your new year be joyful and full of inspiration.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Following is great and flourishing. It is favorable when one holds to what is right, and then there is no fault.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder hidden in the middle of a lake is the image of following. So the wise person, as evening comes, goes home to rest in stillness.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Moving thunder yields beneath the gentle lake, like a strong one who steps down so that others are glad to follow. True following is not drifting with the current without principle. It is knowing what to follow and what to let go. One who wants others to follow must first learn to follow well, and must know when to rest, like thunder falling quiet in winter. If what is right remains the guide, following brings prosperity without blame.
linesEn: Duties and positions are changing. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. Going out the gate to meet people brings results. When things around you change, open your heart and meet many people. Do not stay inside your own small circle.
Tying yourself to the small child, you lose the grown man. If you cling to small things close at hand, you will miss what is worth more.

Tying yourself to the grown man, you leave the small child behind. Following like this, you find whatever you seek. It is good to stay on the right path. Choosing to follow something greater means giving up something else, but you must keep your own integrity.

Following that brings gain is unfortunate, even if you hold firm. If you are sincere and on the right path, and act with clarity, what fault could there be? When people begin to follow you, perhaps even more than they follow your superior, keep your sincerity and your intentions open and clear.
Being sincere toward what is good brings good fortune. Following goodness with an honest heart brings success.
Bind it tight, then wind another cord around it. The king offers sacrifice on the Western Mountain. The deepest bond becomes devotion, which reaches to what is sacred.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: One who follows the times does not struggle against the current in vain. What will you let flow away today?

yearMessageEn.overview: One who follows the times does not struggle in vain. This year, adapting and choosing what is right helps you move smoothly. Rest in rhythm and let go of what is not yours.
yearMessageEn.work: Adapt to the situation, but follow what is right, not just the crowd.
yearMessageEn.love: Give way to each other fittingly, and know when to stand by your own view.
yearMessageEn.money: Adjust plans as things change, but do not follow others without thinking.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you find a fitting path and follow it with ease.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Mending decay is great and flourishing. It is favorable to cross the great river. Reflect for three days before the jia day, and take care for three days after it.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind blowing beneath the mountain is the image of decay that needs mending. So the wise person rouses the people and nourishes virtue so it can grow.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The character 蠱 shows worms in a vessel. It means something left neglected until it spoils, often a problem inherited from earlier generations or built up from long inertia. Wind trapped beneath the mountain cannot pass through, so things turn stale. Yet decay that shows plainly is also a chance to begin anew. Mending takes courage to act, like crossing a great river. But study the cause before acting, and watch the result afterward. Do not blame the past. Take responsibility for the repair with diligence and care.
linesEn: Mending the decay left by the father. With a child like this, the late father has no fault. There is danger, but in the end good fortune. The fault has only just begun. If you correct it quickly and with purpose, even hardship will pass well.
Mending the decay left by the mother. Do not be too strict or harsh. A delicate problem must be mended with gentleness and flexibility.
Mending the decay left by the father. There is a little regret, but no great fault. You may act too forcefully and cause some friction, but your intention is right, so no serious harm is done.
Letting the decay left by the father go unmended. If this goes on, shame will follow. Putting up silently with an old problem only lets it spread until it is too hard to fix.
Mending the decay left by the father, and earning praise. Restoring with virtue and knowing how to use good people brings honor.
Not serving the king or the nobles, and holding one's own affairs in high regard. When worldly duties are done, the wise step back to keep their mind and ideals pure.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: What is left alone for long decays. Today, choose to mend one small thing that has weighed on you.

yearMessageEn.overview: What is left alone for long decays, but it can be mended. This year suits repairing what is unfinished: habits, work and relationships. Reflect before and after you act, then restore it well.
yearMessageEn.work: Deal with old unfinished work. Fix the root cause and work will go better.
yearMessageEn.love: Heal what lingers in your hearts with honest conversation.
yearMessageEn.money: Review old burdens and poor spending habits, then sort them out gradually.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you repair the old and begin anew with grace.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Approach is great and flourishing. It is favorable to hold to what is right. But when the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Earth above the lake is the image of approach. So the wise person teaches and cares for people without end, embracing and protecting them without limit.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Two yang lines are growing from below, like spring drawing near. It is a time when luck and opportunity move toward you, and those in high positions come down to care for those beneath them. Yet all prosperity has its cycle. At its peak it begins to decline, which is why the eighth month is a warning. Use this good time with awareness. Approach people with sincerity and kindness, and prepare your mind for change to come.
linesEn: Approaching together in harmony. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. As you first step toward others in a spirit of accord, keep your honesty.
Approaching together in harmony brings good fortune. Nothing is unfavorable. Strength that holds the middle way and is welcomed can go in any direction.
Approaching with sweet words. Nothing is favorable. If you feel uneasy and correct it, there will be no fault. Pleasing with sweet words but no sincerity cannot last. Reflect and adjust early.
Approaching in the fullest way. No fault. Coming down to others truly and willingly brings no fault.
Approaching with wisdom. This is fitting for a great ruler, and brings good fortune. A wise leader entrusts work to capable people and does not have to do everything personally.
Approaching with generous, steady kindness. Good fortune, no fault. An elder who is still willing to come down and help others with an open heart gains good results.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Good things are drawing near. Prepare your heart, and care for those around you with kindness.

yearMessageEn.overview: Good things are drawing near and strength is growing. This year suits readying your heart, caring for those around you with kindness, and knowing that good times do not last forever. Use them well.
yearMessageEn.work: Opportunity is coming. Prepare yourself and care for your team with kindness.
yearMessageEn.love: Love is growing. Keep tending it steadily so that it lasts.
yearMessageEn.money: The trend is improving, but plan for a time when it may shift.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May good things come toward you, one step at a time.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: The hands are washed, but the offering is not yet made. There is sincere devotion, worthy of awe and respect.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind passing over the earth is the image of observing. So the kings of old toured every direction to observe how the people lived, and set up teachings to suit them.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: This scene is the sacred moment of a ritual offering. The hands have been washed, but the gift is not yet given. The calm and reverence of that moment are stronger than any ceremony. Those in high places are watched by the people, so they must be examples through sincerity, not show. At the same time they must look back at themselves and view the world broadly, like wind passing across the whole land. Deep understanding comes from looking calmly, not from rushing to judge.
linesEn: Looking like a child. For ordinary people there is no fault, but for the wise it is shameful. A shallow view of the world may be forgiven in common people, but one who should have wisdom must look deeper.
Peeping through a crack in the door. This is good only for the faithful woman who stays at home. Looking from one narrow angle shows only part of the picture. Widen your view.
Observing your own life to decide whether to advance or to retreat. Before deciding, review your actions and their results honestly.
Observing the glory of the land. It is favorable to be a guest of the king. Having seen the goodness of the leader, you should bring your abilities to serve.
Observing your own life. The wise person is free of fault. Those in high positions must measure their virtue by how the people they care for are living.
Observing their lives. The wise person is free of fault. Even when free of worldly duties, keep examining yourself, because people still look to you as an example.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Wind passes evenly over the land. Today, pause and observe before you judge anything.

yearMessageEn.overview: Wind passes evenly over the land. This year suits pausing to observe before judging, looking back at yourself, and being a good example, because others see what you quietly do.
yearMessageEn.work: Observe the whole picture before acting, and be an example others can trust.
yearMessageEn.love: See yourself and your loved one with an open heart. Understand before judging.
yearMessageEn.money: Study the facts from all sides before any important decision.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you have clear sight and a calm heart.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Closing the jaws is flourishing. It is favorable to judge legal cases.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder and lightning arriving together is the image of closing jaws. So the kings of old made punishments clear and set the laws in order.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The picture is a mouth held open with something stuck between the teeth. It must be bitten apart before the mouth can close. When an obstacle or a person with bad intent blocks a relationship, it will not simply go away. It must be dealt with decisively, like powerful thunder and lightning that shows the truth. Decisiveness must come with clarity and fairness, not with anger or excessive force.
linesEn: Stocks on the feet hide the toes. No fault. A light penalty while the wrong is still small is a warning to stop before going far astray.
Biting into soft meat so deep the nose is buried. No fault. Dealing with an easy matter, perhaps using a little too much force, is no fault, because the intention is right.

Chewing old dried meat, one meets poison. A little shame, but no fault. When dealing with an old problem that has built up over a long time, you may meet resistance and be hurt a little, but what you do is proper.

Biting into dried meat on the bone, one finds a bronze arrowhead. It is favorable to hold firm in hardship. Good fortune. The obstacle is strong, so it takes the hardness of metal and the straightness of an arrow to get through.

Biting into dried meat, one finds yellow gold. Hold firm with awareness of danger. No fault. One who holds the power to judge must keep to the middle way and impartiality, and always remember the weight of the duty.
A cangue on the neck hides the ears. Misfortune. One who will not heed warnings until faults pile up beyond repair suffers serious harm.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: What blocks the way will not vanish by itself. Is there a matter to settle firmly and fairly today?

yearMessageEn.overview: What blocks the way will not go away by itself. This year, settle unfinished matters firmly and fairly, without harshness. Decide clearly, follow the rules, and the way opens.
yearMessageEn.work: Clear the obstacles blocking your work. Decide firmly and fairly.
yearMessageEn.love: Speak plainly about what is unresolved, in a tone that does not hurt each other.
yearMessageEn.money: Put debts or lingering burdens in order, with honesty.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May every obstacle of yours be resolved fairly.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Adornment is flourishing. There is some small benefit in going forward.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire burning beneath the mountain is the image of adornment. So the wise person makes the affairs of daily life clear, but does not dare use it to decide great legal cases.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Firelight at the foot of the mountain makes it look beautiful, but it cannot shine far. Beauty, manners and form give life refinement and help people live together in harmony. Yet they are only a covering around the essence. So they suit small matters better than deciding large ones. Use beauty to support the truth, not to hide it, and remember that the highest beauty is pure simplicity.
linesEn: Adorning one's own feet. Leaving the carriage to walk on foot. One in a low position is content with simplicity and does not accept comforts that do not suit them.
Adorning the beard. Beauty that is only an accessory must follow what is essential, like a beard that moves with the chin.

Adorned splendidly, glossy as if moist. Holding firmly to what is right to the end brings good fortune. When everything is lovely and pleasant, take care not to sink into the pleasure and forget your principles.

Adorned splendidly or in pure white. A white horse gallops as if it had wings. It is no robber, but comes to ask for marriage. You must choose between luxury and simplicity. What looks suspicious at first may be a true friend who comes with honest intent.
Adornment in a garden on the hillside. The silk brought as a gift is very little, which seems embarrassing, but in the end there is good fortune. Simple sincerity is worth more than a lavish gift.
Plain white beauty. No fault. When adornment reaches its limit, it returns to simplicity, which is true beauty.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Outer beauty lifts the heart, but do not forget to ask whether the core within is still well.

yearMessageEn.overview: Outer beauty lifts the heart, but the core within matters more. This year you may attend to form and presentation, as long as you keep simplicity and sincerity, which are the essence.
yearMessageEn.work: Care about presentation and detail, but put substance and sincerity first.
yearMessageEn.love: Small, lovely gestures please the heart, but they need sincerity behind them.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend moderately on beautiful things, and be clear about what is truly needed.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your life be beautiful, outside and within.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: In a time of wearing away, it is not favorable to undertake anything.
hexagrams.imageEn: The mountain resting on the earth is the image of peeling away. So those above strengthen the foundation below, so that the home will be secure and calm.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Five yin lines are eating upward until only one yang line remains at the top, like a mountain eroded until only the peak is left, or leaves falling at the end of the season. At this time what is inferior has the upper hand over what is good. Pushing forward or resisting directly will only do more harm. Stay still, accept the passing of time, strengthen your own foundation and look after those beneath you. When decline reaches its limit, recovery follows.
linesEn: The leg of the bed is gnawed away. What is right is destroyed. Misfortune. Decline begins at the lowest foundation. Notice the first signs and be careful.
The frame of the bed is gnawed away. What is right is destroyed. Misfortune. Decline has crept closer to you, and no one has yet come to help.
In the midst of wearing away. No fault. Though among those in decline, you still keep ties with the good above. Separating from those of little worth is no fault.
The bed is gnawed away to the skin. Misfortune. Harm reaches you directly and can no longer be avoided.
A string of fish, and the palace ladies brought in turn to receive favor. Nothing is unfavorable. When yin yields to order and obeys the good, the situation turns for the better.

A great fruit not yet eaten. The wise person gains a carriage. The petty person tears down even the roof over their own head. The seed of goodness remains and will grow again. Those of virtue will be supported, but destroyers destroy their own shelter.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Leaves fall so the tree can rest. Whatever is fading, try letting it go calmly.

yearMessageEn.overview: Leaves fall so the tree can rest. This year some things may fade, but it is a chance to guard your foundation, be patient, stay steady in what matters, and calmly release the rest.
yearMessageEn.work: Do not force expansion now. Protect what is fundamental first.
yearMessageEn.love: If something in the relationship is changing, stay calm and keep its core.
yearMessageEn.money: Cut needless spending and keep what matters secure.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you have firm roots even when the leaves fall.

hexagrams.meaningEn: Coming back, a turning point to recovery
hexagrams.judgmentEn: Return is flourishing. Going out and coming in bring no illness. Friends come and there is no fault. Turning back to one's own way, it comes again on the seventh day. It is favorable to undertake anything.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder within the earth is the image of return. So the kings of old closed the passes at the winter solstice. Merchants and travelers did not journey, and the ruler did not inspect the realm.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: After the darkness has reached its limit, the first yang light has come back to the bottom, like the winter solstice when daylight begins to grow again. The new energy is still young, so it must be treated gently and calmly, without haste, like closing the passes so the seedling of life can grow. This is a time to return to your true self, correct what went astray, and begin again in step with nature's rhythm. Those with the same purpose will slowly gather again.
linesEn: Returning from not far away. No cause for deep regret. Great good fortune. Realizing you were wrong and turning back while you have not strayed far is the best way.
A beautiful return. Good fortune. Turning back by learning from a virtuous person nearby goes smoothly.
Returning again and again. Danger, but no fault. Straying and returning over and over is worrying, but as long as you keep trying to return, it is not quite a fault.
In the middle of the crowd, one turns back alone. Even if those around go another way, you dare to choose the right path by yourself.
Returning with a firm heart. No regret. Honest and steady self-examination makes the return firm and unshaken.

Lost on the way back. Misfortune and disaster. If you send out an army, in the end it will suffer great defeat, and it is unfortunate for the ruler too. For ten years it cannot recover enough to fight. One who misses the chance to turn back and persists brings lasting harm on themselves and others.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: After the longest night, light begins to return. It is not too late to begin again today.

yearMessageEn.overview: After the longest night, light begins to return. This year is a good turning point. You can always return to the right path and start again, even if the first step is small and the light is faint.
yearMessageEn.work: Begin again, or return to what you set aside. A small step counts as a start.
yearMessageEn.love: A relationship that grew distant may become warm again if you reach out first.
yearMessageEn.money: Start a new, healthy money habit and recover step by step.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May the new year be a bright beginning for you.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: No pretense is great and flourishing. It is favorable to hold to what is right. Whoever is not in the right meets danger, and it is not favorable to undertake anything.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder moving across all under heaven, and all things awaken without pretense. So the kings of old acted fully in accord with the seasons and nourished all things to grow.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Thunder moves beneath heaven. This is action in harmony with heaven, with no scheming or hidden greed. No pretense is an upright heart like nature, which does not calculate gain and loss. When the heart is pure, everything flows. But if there is a hidden intent to twist things, trouble follows on its own. This scene also warns that sometimes unexpected misfortune visits those who did nothing wrong. Meet it calmly, without panic and without trying to force the outcome.
linesEn: No pretense. Going forward brings good fortune. Action that comes from a truly pure heart fulfills its wish.

Plow without thinking of the harvest; clear new land without thinking of the third-year field. Then it is favorable to undertake things. Do what is in front of you as well as you can, without clinging to the reward.
Misfortune that one did not cause. Someone ties up an ox, a traveler leads it away, and the villagers are the ones suspected. Sometimes harm falls on the innocent for no reason. Meet it with calm.
One can hold firm. No fault. Keep your integrity steady and there is nothing to worry about.
Illness that one did not cause. Without medicine there will be cause for joy. A problem not caused by your own fault will clear up by itself. Do not hurry to use a remedy that is misplaced or wrong.

Even without pretense, if you move there is danger. Nothing is favorable. When you have reached the end of the road, even good intentions should not push on. Stand still and wait for the right moment.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Do what should be done with an honest heart, and loosen your expectations of the result a little.

yearMessageEn.overview: A natural, pure heart is your guide. This year the unexpected may happen. Do what is right without hoping too much for reward, and do not force what is unnatural.
yearMessageEn.work: Work with honesty and no scheming. Be ready for the unexpected.
yearMessageEn.love: Sincerity with no expectation is the best foundation for love.
yearMessageEn.money: Expect no windfalls. Do what is right and keep a reserve for surprises.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your heart be pure and good things come unexpectedly.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Great storing is favorable when one holds to what is right. Not eating at home brings good fortune. It is favorable to cross the great river.
hexagrams.imageEn: Heaven within the mountain is the image of great storing. So the wise person studies the words and deeds of the sages of the past in depth, in order to store up their own virtue.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The mountain holds the strength of heaven within it, like a treasure gathered in a valley. Powerful creative energy is restrained and nurtured until it becomes deep knowledge and virtue. This is a time to learn, patiently gather strength, and, when ready, go out to serve society, not keeping your ability only at home. Restraint today is the base for going far tomorrow.
linesEn: There is danger, so it is favorable to stop. When checked from the start, forcing ahead would be dangerous. Stopping to wait for the right moment is wise.
The carriage has its axle removed. Knowing how to stop on your own, in the middle way, there is no error.

Good horses gallop after one another. It is favorable to hold firm in hardship. Practice driving and defense every day, and then it is favorable to undertake things. When the road opens, go forward carefully and always be prepared.
A board fixed on the horns of a young calf. Great good fortune. Restraining strength while it is still young is easy and gives the best result.
The tusks of a gelded pig. Good fortune. Fix the cause of the fierceness instead of fighting the symptoms, and the violence fades by itself.
The road of heaven lies open. Flourishing. Storing has reached its limit. Every road opens, and the strength you nurtured can now spread freely.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: The mountain holds great strength within. Today, try storing up more than rushing to use.

yearMessageEn.overview: Great storing calls for restraint. This year suits learning from the past and nurturing virtue and knowledge. Let strength stay within until it is ready, then release it with direction.
yearMessageEn.work: Build up knowledge and experience. No need to show all your strength yet.
yearMessageEn.love: Learn from the past of the relationship, and use it to grow.
yearMessageEn.money: Save with discipline. Keep your strength and resources for the right moment.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you gather what is good and be ready to go far.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Nourishment that holds to what is right brings good fortune. Observe who nourishes what, and observe what one seeks to feed one's own mouth.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder beneath the mountain is the image of nourishment. So the wise person is careful with words and moderate in eating and drinking.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The picture is an open mouth. The lower jaw moves like thunder, and the upper jaw stays still like a mountain. What goes into the mouth nourishes the body. What comes out of the mouth nourishes or harms others. To know someone, see what they nourish and how they nourish themselves. Nourish both body and mind with what is right, rely mainly on yourself, and use your ability to nourish others as is fitting.
linesEn: You set aside your sacred tortoise and watch me chew with open jaws. Misfortune. One who gives up their own worth and ability and envies what others have brings trouble on themselves.

Nourishment turned upside down, against the proper way, turning to the high hill for support. Going forward brings misfortune. Relying on the wrong person or the wrong way leads you away from what is right.

Going against the principle of nourishment. Even holding firm brings misfortune. For ten years it cannot be used. Nothing is favorable. Feeding yourself with endless craving destroys you for a long time.

Nourishment turned upside down, but good fortune. Eyes fixed like a tiger's, desire chasing without pause. No fault. One in a high position who earnestly seeks help from below in order to nourish the people is not at fault.
Against the proper way, but holding to what is right brings good fortune. One cannot cross the great river. When your own strength is not enough, rely on the wise and do not risk a great undertaking.

The source of nourishment. There is danger, but good fortune. It is favorable to cross the great river. One on whom everyone relies must be aware of the heavy burden, and only then dares to take on a great undertaking.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: What we eat, say and think all feed our life. What are you nourishing today?

yearMessageEn.overview: The jaws remind us of nourishment, in what we eat and what we say. This year, guard your words, be moderate in taking and giving, and choose what truly feeds body and mind.
yearMessageEn.work: Mind your words at work, and nourish yourself with what has real value.
yearMessageEn.love: Kind words feed love. Beware of words that hurt.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend moderately, and rely on yourself before waiting on others.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be nourished in body and mind all year.

hexagrams.meaningEn: Great excess, a burden too heavy
hexagrams.judgmentEn: The roof beam bends. It is favorable to undertake anything. Flourishing.
hexagrams.imageEn: The lake flooding until it drowns the trees is the image of great excess. So the wise person can stand alone without fear and can withdraw from the world without resentment.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Four yang lines are packed in the middle, while both ends are weak yin, like a beam bearing so much weight that it sags. This is a special time when the burden is heavier than usual. Ordinary methods do not work, so one must dare to do something unusual to ease the situation. But it must be done gently and with understanding, not with stubborn force. The wise in such a time need a steady heart and the courage to stand firm even with no one beside them.
linesEn: White thatch grass laid beneath. No fault. When the burden is heavy, careful attention from the very start prevents damage.
A withered willow sprouts new shoots. An old man takes a young wife. Nothing is unfavorable. What was fading is fed by new strength and regains life.
The roof beam bends. Misfortune. One who stubbornly carries the load and will not accept help will collapse.
The roof beam bows upward and holds. Good fortune. But if there is some other motive, it brings shame. One who carries a burden steadily must not be swayed by temptation or self-interest.
A withered willow bears flowers. An old woman takes a young husband. No fault, but no merit either. A brief blooming of what is nearly spent cannot build anything lasting.
Wading through deep water until it covers the head. Misfortune, but no fault. Sacrificing oneself for what is right, even if it brings ruin, brings no fault.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A sagging beam says the load is too much. Is there a burden to set down today, or help to ask for?

yearMessageEn.overview: A beam sags when the load is too heavy. This year you may have much to carry. Stand firm inside, do not carry everything alone, and take care not to break before it passes.
yearMessageEn.work: The workload is heavy. Set priorities and ask for help before you fall.
yearMessageEn.love: Do not let stress drive you apart. Tell your loved one what you need.
yearMessageEn.money: Expenses may weigh heavily. Review them and cut what is beyond your means.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you stand firm and find a hand to steady you.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: A deep pit within a deep pit. If you are sincere, the heart flourishes, and your actions will be honored.
hexagrams.imageEn: Water flowing on without end is the image of pit upon pit. So the wise person keeps virtue constant and practices teaching without pause.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Water upon water, danger upon danger, like one who has fallen into a gorge and finds another pit beneath. But water teaches us how to pass through danger. It flows forward without stopping, fills every hollow before moving on, and never loses its nature wherever it is. In hard times, keep sincerity as your core. Do not panic. Make your way through one step at a time, patiently and steadily, and the way out will appear on its own.
linesEn: Pit upon pit. Falling into the bottom of the deep pit. Misfortune. Growing used to danger until you lose your way, you only sink deeper and deeper.
There is danger within the pit. Seeking a little, you may gain a little. You cannot yet escape fully. Be content with progress a little at a time.

Coming or going, it is all pit. Dangerous and deep. Fallen to the bottom of the pit, do nothing. When every way is dangerous, struggling makes things worse. Stay still and wait for the situation to ease.

One flask of wine and two bowls of rice in plain clay ware, handed through the window. In the end, no fault. In hard times, simple sincerity and meeting without ceremony are worth more than any formality.
The pit is not yet full, only leveled off. No fault. Danger is nearly past, but it is not yet time to be ambitious. Be content with having come through.

Bound with a triple-twisted rope and kept in a thicket of thorns. For three years there is no escape. Misfortune. One who loses the way to the end of the road in danger stays entangled for a long time.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Water passes through deep pits without losing itself. The way is hard, yet a steady heart is still yours.

yearMessageEn.overview: Danger upon danger is like a deep pit, but water never stops flowing or loses itself. This year a steady heart and a gentle flow will see you through hard times.
yearMessageEn.work: Get through the hard stretch with honesty and steady effort. Keep learning.
yearMessageEn.love: In uncertainty, being sincere and staying side by side helps most.
yearMessageEn.money: Take special care, check every time, and do not risk beyond your means.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your heart be steady like water passing every obstacle.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Brightness is favorable when one holds to what is right. Flourishing. Raising a cow brings good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Brightness arising twice over is the image of fire. So the great person carries on the light without break and shines to all four directions.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Fire cannot blaze by itself. It must cling to fuel to give light, like the sun clinging to the sky and plants clinging to the earth. So light and wisdom must cling to what is right. Gentle, docile humility, like a cow, helps the fire of wisdom burn lastingly without consuming itself. Know what you depend on, and let your light guide others steadily.
linesEn: Footsteps in confusion. With reverence and care there is no fault. At the beginning, when many matters come at once, steady your mind before you step.
Yellow light. Great good fortune. Brightness resting fittingly in the middle way, like the gentle light of the midday sun, is perfection.

Light of the setting sun. If one does not beat the clay jar and sing, one will lament old age. Misfortune. Every life comes to its time of fading. Accept it with a cheerful heart instead of grieving and fearing.
It rushes in all at once: it flares, it burns out, it is abandoned. Violence that comes suddenly burns out quickly and cannot last.
Tears pouring, sorrowful lament, but good fortune. True sorrow and deep awareness in a time of crisis lead to a good change.

The king marches out to put down rebels and wins. He strikes down the ringleader and takes only the chiefs captive, not their followers. No fault. Remove the root of the evil, but be merciful to those who were led along.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Fire shines because it has fuel. What is the fuel that keeps a light in your heart today?

yearMessageEn.overview: Fire needs fuel to burn bright. This year wisdom and clarity lead the way. Cling to what is right and keep your humility, so that the light is warm and does not scorch.
yearMessageEn.work: Your thinking grows clearer. Let wisdom lead your work and stay humble.
yearMessageEn.love: Give warmth without scorching. Gentleness keeps love bright and lasting.
yearMessageEn.money: Hold to sound principles and see clearly before deciding about money.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May wisdom and warmth light your path through the new year.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Sensing is flourishing. It is favorable to hold to what is right. Taking a wife brings good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: A lake on top of the mountain is the image of sensing. So the wise person keeps the heart empty in order to receive others.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The mountain, like a young man, lowers himself beneath the lake, like a young woman. The lake's moisture seeps down to nourish the mountain. This is the picture of natural attraction and mutual awareness, in love, in friendship, and in winning others over. True sensing comes from an empty, humble heart, not from force or hidden intent. Listen with the heart, be open to others, and let the relationship grow naturally.
linesEn: Feeling in the big toe. The impulse has only just begun to stir and shows no result yet. It is only an intention not yet acted on.
Feeling in the calf. Misfortune. Staying still brings good fortune. Rushing to move on an impulse without waiting for the right moment leads to mistakes. Be patient and wait.
Feeling in the thigh. Clinging to following others. If you go forward, there will be shame. Running after other people's wishes with no principle loses your own self.

Holding firm to what is right brings good fortune, and regret disappears. If the heart is restless, going back and forth, only close friends will follow your thoughts. Influence from a pure heart spreads widely, but deliberate calculation reaches only a narrow circle.
Feeling in the back. No regret. Steadiness that is not shaken may not touch deeply, but it will not bring regret.
Feeling in the jaw, cheeks and tongue. Persuading with shallow words and no sincerity cannot touch anyone's heart.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A still heart can sense others. Today, try feeling what the people close to you are feeling.

yearMessageEn.overview: Mountain and lake attract each other naturally. This year feelings and mutual awareness are strong. Open your heart gently, but do not let emotion run so fast that you forget sincerity.
yearMessageEn.work: Listen openly to colleagues. Understanding each other keeps work smooth.
yearMessageEn.love: Attraction and understanding are strong. Open your heart gently and sincerely.
yearMessageEn.money: Do not decide about money on a passing mood. Balance feeling with reason.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you find understanding hearts and a warm love.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Constancy is flourishing. No fault. It is favorable to hold to what is right. It is favorable to undertake anything.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder and wind together are the image of constancy. So the wise person stands firm and does not change direction.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Thunder and wind never stop moving, yet they stay together for all time, like a husband and wife who stay together for many years. Constancy is not standing still. It is moving steadily by a principle that does not change, like the seasons that turn and the sun and moon that travel without end. Hold a steady goal. You may adjust your methods to the situation, but do not abandon your core, and do not rush to expect quick results.
linesEn: Digging deep in search of constancy. Even if you hold firm, misfortune. Nothing is favorable. Demanding deep stability from the very start, without giving time to build it gradually, leads to error.
Regret disappears. Even if the position is not suitable, keeping steadily to the middle way keeps you free of error.
Not constant in one's own virtue. One may meet disgrace. Even holding firm brings shame. One who changes principles with the mood is trusted by no one.
Hunting in the field but catching no game at all. Striving for a long time in the wrong place or by the wrong method brings no result, however hard you try.

Constant in one's own virtue, holding to what is right. For a woman, good fortune. For a man, misfortune. Obeying and following faithfully suits a follower, but a leader must know how to decide and adapt as fitting.
Constancy that keeps shaking. Misfortune. Restlessness that keeps changing back and forth destroys everything that was built.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: What lasts comes from steady repetition. Which small habit do you want to keep today?

yearMessageEn.overview: Constancy comes from steadily holding to principle. This year there is no need to hurry or change direction often. Keep to what is right, be patient, and walk on evenly. Results will come.
yearMessageEn.work: Keep doing what is right, steadily. Consistency beats haste.
yearMessageEn.love: Keep the relationship going with steadiness, not with grand gestures.
yearMessageEn.money: Keep your discipline and long-term plan. Do not switch about with the trend.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you stay steady and lasting in the good you hold to.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Retreat is flourishing. In small matters it still helps to hold firmly to what is right.
hexagrams.imageEn: Beneath the sky stands a mountain: the picture of retreat. The wise person keeps away from petty people, not out of hatred, but with dignity and strict discipline toward themselves.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The dark force is rising from below, like long shadows at dusk. Pushing against it now would only bring loss. Retreat is not defeat but the wisdom of knowing heaven's timing. Step back calmly, without anger, and do not shut the door so hard that relationships break. Keep your strength for the day when the times favor you again.
linesEn: Retreating at the very tail of the line is dangerous. Do not start anything or go anywhere. When you are in the slowest place to withdraw, stay still for now. Hasty movement only exposes you to harm.
Bound with yellow ox hide, which no one can loosen. A steady will that stays true to what is right holds so firmly that nothing can pull it away.

Retreating while ties still hold you back brings distress and danger. Yet caring for servants and household brings good results. Concern keeps you from leaving cleanly, so spend that attachment on small matters at home, not on great ones.

Retreating while the heart still holds affection. This brings good fortune to the wise person, but not to the petty. A person with inner discipline can let go of what they love, while one who follows their own wishes is dragged back by attachment.
