A graceful retreat. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. A retreat that is well timed and courteous offends no one, and so keeps both oneself and goodwill intact.
A retreat that is full and carefree. Nothing fails to help. One who has fully let go, with no bond holding them back, departs lightly and in happiness.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Stepping back at the right time is wisdom. Is there something today you do not need to get involved in?

yearMessageEn.overview: Retreating with good timing is not running away. This year, keep yourself apart from what does not suit you. Step back when it is right, save your strength, and return when the time is ready.
yearMessageEn.work: Step back from tasks that are not yours and from unsuitable people.
yearMessageEn.love: Give each other some space. A fitting distance lets the heart breathe.
yearMessageEn.money: Pull back from spending or commitments beyond your means. Look after yourself.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you know when to step back and return strong.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Great strength. It helps to hold firmly to what is right.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder rolls above the sky: the picture of great strength. The wise person therefore takes no step that goes against propriety and rightness.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Yang energy has grown to its fullest and overflows, like thunder shaking the whole sky. You have a great deal of strength now, but true strength is controlled and rests on what is right. One who charges at everything, like a ram against a fence, gets stuck, unable to retreat or advance. Use your power within limits, know when to stop, and let rightness lead your strength.
linesEn: Strength in the toes. Pushing ahead brings danger. Even when confidence is full, a power that has only just begun is not yet steady, and rushing forward invites misfortune.
Holding to what is right brings good fortune. You stand in the balanced middle, with strength but no excess. This balance is what brings good results.

The petty use force; the wise do not. Even holding firm, there is danger. The ram butts the fence and gets caught. Showing off your power traps you, so the wise keep their strength in reserve and do not display it carelessly.

Holding to what is right brings good fortune. Regret fades. The fence opens and nothing holds you. Strength lies in the axle of a great cart. Move ahead steadily and on the right path, and obstacles open the way by themselves.
Losing the ram easily on the plain. No regret. When you can set down stubbornness and hardness, there is nothing left to regret.

The ram butts the fence: it cannot retreat and cannot advance. Nothing helps. But if you recognize the difficulty, there is good fortune. Pushing stubbornly to the end leads to a dead end. Accepting the truth and cooling down is the way out.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: True strength knows how to hold back. Before you push today, ask whether you should.

yearMessageEn.overview: Strength that serves what is right is beautiful. This year you have much power, but show restraint and do not use force beyond what is fitting. Real strength is knowing when to stop.
yearMessageEn.work: You have energy to push work forward. Use it fairly and do not pressure others.
yearMessageEn.love: Show your steadiness gently. Do not let strength turn into control.
yearMessageEn.money: Your earning power is strong, but spend with thought and within your means.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be strong and kind through the new year.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Advance. The lord who brings peace to the land is rewarded with many horses, and is received in audience three times in one day.
hexagrams.imageEn: The sun rises above the earth: the picture of advance. The wise person therefore polishes the bright virtue within until it shines by itself.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The sun climbs from the horizon, and its light spreads everywhere without hurry. This is a time of progress and of earning the trust of those above you. Success comes from loyal service and from bringing calm to the people around you. Let your light shine from inner virtue, not from boasting, and do not worry about small gains and losses along the way.
linesEn: Advancing and being blocked. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. Even if you are not yet trusted, keep a generous heart and you will be without fault. At the start, when no one yet sees your worth, do not be anxious. Staying calm will carry you through.

Advancing with sorrow. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. You will receive a great blessing from the royal grandmother. The worry of having no support will ease when a kind elder reaches out a hand.
All the people agree. Regret fades. When the trust of the group is yours, progress is smooth and free of heavy burden.
Advancing like a field rat. Even holding firm, there is danger. One who climbs through greed and hides in a high place without real ability stands on risky ground.

Regret fades. Do not fret over gain or loss. Going forward brings good fortune, and nothing fails to help. In a high position with an open heart, let go of worry about gains and losses and simply do what is right.

Advancing to the very horns. It serves only for subduing one's own town. There is danger but good fortune, and no fault. But clinging to it brings shame. Hardness at its extreme should be used only to curb the faults in oneself or one's household. Used on others, it goes too far.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Dawn rises slowly from the earth. Progress comes in the open. Let your virtue be your light.

yearMessageEn.overview: The sun rises over the land. This year brings progress and recognition. Your virtue shines brighter. Move forward with humility and do not forget those who helped you along the way.
yearMessageEn.work: Your work is recognized. Advance through good character and humility.
yearMessageEn.love: The relationship moves ahead brightly. Thank the people who stand beside you.
yearMessageEn.money: The trend is forward. Spend carefully and keep your security in mind.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your light grow brighter every day of the new year.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: The light is dimmed. It helps to hold firmly to what is right amid hardship.
hexagrams.imageEn: The sun sinks beneath the earth: the picture of dimmed light. The wise person therefore governs people by keeping their cleverness inside, using darkness as a cloak while the heart stays bright.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Now the sun has gone from the sky, and the virtuous fall under the power of the blind. Showing your ability or your rightness openly may bring danger on yourself. Be like Jizi, who made himself unnoticed to preserve his life and his ideals. On the outside, be gentle and yielding. Inside, stay bright and steady. The darkness does not last forever, and the light will return in its own time.
linesEn: Light dimmed while in flight, wings drooping. The wise person sets out, going three days without eating, and wherever they go, their hosts speak ill of them. When you see danger from far off, withdraw quickly, even at the cost of hardship and being misunderstood. That is better than being caught in danger.
Light dimmed. Wounded in the left thigh. Using a strong horse to help brings good fortune. Though hurt, the wound is not deadly. Hurry to help yourself and others with the strength you have.

Light dimmed while hunting in the south, and the great leader is caught. Do not rush to fix everything at once. Even when there is a chance to remove the root of the darkness, change must come gradually.

Entering the left side of the belly, you grasp the heart of the one who dims the light, then leave through the gate of the house. When you understand the true nature of the situation, depart before it is too late.
Light dimmed, like Jizi. It helps to hold firmly to what is right. Jizi pretended to be mad to escape the tyrant, yet his heart kept hold of what is right. Hide your light inside in just this way.
No light, only darkness. At first rising to the sky, later falling to the ground. One who dims the light of others may flourish for a while, but in the end brings about their own ruin.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: In dark times, keep the light in your heart quietly. Not everyone needs to see it right now.

yearMessageEn.overview: Dimmed light still burns within. This year you may need to hide your light, endure the dark, watch for danger and keep your heart true without standing out. In time, the light returns.
yearMessageEn.work: Work quietly, mind your words and protect what matters to you.
yearMessageEn.love: Support each other through hard times. Being there matters more than words.
yearMessageEn.money: Be careful and low-key. Do not show off what you have. Protect what matters.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May the light in your heart stay warm and never go out.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: The family. It helps when the woman holds firmly to what is right.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind comes out from fire: the picture of the family. The wise person therefore speaks with substance and acts with steady consistency.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The family is the foundation of everything. When each person keeps to their own role rightly, the home is steady and warm, like a fire in the hearth sending warmth out on the wind. Influence outside begins with order inside. Set an example with sincere words and steady actions. Love with limits and firmness with kindness make the home a refuge for everyone.
linesEn: Set rules in the household from the start. Regret fades. Setting clear boundaries at the beginning prevents problems that would come later.

She does not go off to do as she pleases but stays to see to the food in the kitchen. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. Doing your duty with care and without self-will is the heart that holds a home together.

The household is sternly rebuked. Though there is regret and danger, there is good fortune. If wife and children laugh and play without limits, in the end there is shame. Too much strictness may feel stifling, but it is still better than neglect that leaves no order.
Making the household prosper. Great good fortune. One who looks after the family's wealth and livelihood with care brings flourishing to everyone.
The king comes to his own family. Do not worry. Good fortune. A leader who cares for the family with love and virtue is loved in return and has nothing to fear.
Having sincerity and a dignified bearing brings good fortune in the end. The respect that comes from one's own sincerity keeps the family at peace for the long run.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Peace at home starts with small words. Today, try saying one kind thing to someone in your household.

yearMessageEn.overview: Family is the base of everything. This year, pay attention to your roles at home and to those close to you. Warmth, honest words and setting an example will do good in every part of life.
yearMessageEn.work: Do your duties well and set an example. Stability at home supports your work.
yearMessageEn.love: Care for the people at home in word and deed. Warmth begins with what is near.
yearMessageEn.money: Plan family finances together. Talk openly and honestly.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your home be warm and full of smiles.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Divergence. In small matters there is still good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire above, a lake below: the picture of divergence. The wise person therefore walks together with others, yet keeps their own character.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Fire climbs upward while lake water runs downward, each going its own way, like people who live together but are not of one mind. This is no time to expect great success, but small matters can still go well. Difference need not mean enmity if you can find common ground without giving up your principles. What looks frightening is often only a misunderstanding. When suspicion eases, friends appear.
linesEn: Regret fades. If a horse is lost, do not chase it. It will return by itself. Meeting a bad person brings no fault. What is yours comes back without your grasping, and not turning away those you disagree with lessens the bitterness.
Meeting the master in a narrow lane. No fault. When the proper channels are blocked, a chance meeting outside the usual way can still lead to understanding.

Seeing the cart dragged back and the ox held, the driver's hair shaved and his nose cut. A bad start but a good end. At first everything seems stuck and shameful, but with patience the final result is good.

Alone in opposition, you meet a worthy person, and each deals sincerely with the other. There is danger but no fault. In loneliness there is someone who understands. Sincerity will bring you a true ally.

Regret fades. Your kin bite through the soft flesh with ease. What fault could there be in going to them? When you meet someone of like mind, the barrier between you is thin and easy to pass. Step toward them without hesitation.

Alone in opposition, you see a pig covered in mud and a cart full of ghosts. First you draw the bow, later you lay it down. They are not robbers but suitors. Going on and meeting rain brings good fortune. Suspicion makes everything look like an enemy. When you see clearly, you find a friend. The tension eases like rain washing away the dust.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Fire rises, water sinks. We can differ without being enemies. Today, respect someone's difference.

yearMessageEn.overview: Fire and lake move apart, yet difference is also where cooperation begins. This year you may meet misunderstandings or clashing views. Start with small things and look for common ground.
yearMessageEn.work: You may disagree. Start with small points you can settle, then expand.
yearMessageEn.love: Difference is no enemy. Listen and seek common ground before blaming anyone.
yearMessageEn.money: Talk money through clearly with those involved. Do not guess each other's minds.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you understand difference and find common ground.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Obstruction. It helps to go southwest, not northeast. It helps to meet a great person. Holding firmly to what is right brings good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Water on top of a mountain: the picture of obstruction. The wise person therefore turns back to examine themselves and cultivate virtue.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Ahead lies rushing water and behind stands a steep mountain. Pushing straight through only meets blockage. Southwest means the level, easy road, while northeast is the mountain path, harder still. At this time, choose the easier way, seek a wise person to guide you, and use the obstacle as a chance to turn back and mend yourself. When you are ready, the way will open.
linesEn: Going forward meets obstruction; coming back brings praise. Knowing to stop and wait when you see an obstacle earns respect as a wise person.
The king's minister meets obstruction upon obstruction, but not through any fault of his own. When duty requires pushing through hardship, give it your all and do not blame yourself.
Going forward meets obstruction, so he comes back. Returning to those close to you and to your own base brings warmth and encouragement.
Going forward meets obstruction; coming back, he forms a bond. On your own you cannot go on. Join forces with others first.
Great obstruction, and friends come to help. In the most critical time, one who stands firm on what is right will have people come to join hands.

Going forward meets obstruction; coming back brings a great result. Good fortune. It helps to meet a great person. Even after you break free, turn back to help others and rely on the advice of the wise.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: When the road ahead is blocked, turn and look at yourself, and do not hesitate to ask for advice.

yearMessageEn.overview: A mountain lies ahead and water behind. If you meet obstacles this year, look at yourself, ask advice from someone you trust, and wait for the moment. Pausing to think may be the best way out.
yearMessageEn.work: When stuck, pause and review yourself. Ask for advice from an expert or mentor.
yearMessageEn.love: When stuck in a relationship, look at yourself first, then talk together.
yearMessageEn.money: Do not push on with what you are unsure of. Ask for advice before deciding.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you find a helping hand and a path that opens.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Release. It helps to go southwest. If there is nothing to be done, returning to normal brings good fortune. If there is something to be done, acting early brings good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder rolls and rain comes down: the picture of release. The wise person therefore forgives mistakes and eases the punishment of wrongdoers.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: After a thunderstorm the air turns clear. Tension that built up for a long time has eased. This is a time to recover and return to simplicity. Do not dig up old matters or seek revenge. Forgive and begin again. If anything is still unfinished, settle it as soon as possible before it comes back to cause trouble.
linesEn: No fault. When trouble has just passed, resting and living quietly is the right thing to do.
Hunting three foxes in the field and getting a yellow arrow. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. Removing the cunning with fairness and the middle way brings good results.
Carrying a load while riding in a cart invites robbers to come. Even holding firm, there is shame. Showing off beyond your station or displaying what is not yours invites harm.
Release your big toe, and then friends will come in sincerity. Shake off those who cling to you insincerely, and true friends will draw near.
The wise person can free themselves. Good fortune. Even the petty come to trust them. When you truly cut what is bad out of yourself, even those who were once a problem accept it and step away.
The lord shoots a hawk on a high wall and gets it. Nothing fails to help. When the time is right, dealing with the last root of the trouble decisively and completely releases everything.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: After the storm the air clears. Is there something today you are ready to forgive and let go?

yearMessageEn.overview: Thunder and rain relieve the tightness. This year is a time of easing, forgiveness and new starts. Once trouble eases, act in good time and do not drag old matters back.
yearMessageEn.work: Lingering problems ease. Hurry to settle them, then move on.
yearMessageEn.love: Forgive and let old things go. The relationship becomes lighter and warmer.
yearMessageEn.money: Financial burdens begin to lighten. Tidy up what remains.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May every tightness in your life ease in the new year.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Reduction with sincerity brings great good fortune. No fault. You may hold firm. It helps to go forward. What to use for the offering? Two simple bowls are enough.
hexagrams.imageEn: Beneath the mountain lies a lake: the picture of reduction. The wise person therefore restrains anger and blocks desire.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The lake below evaporates to nourish the mountain above. The lower part gives itself up so the upper part may flourish. This is a time to live simply and reduce excess, in wealth and in the heart. Sincerity matters more than luxury. A small offering is enough if the heart is pure. Reducing anger and craving is the reduction that bears the most fruit.
linesEn: Finishing your own tasks, you hurry to help. No fault. But consider how much to reduce yourself. Helping others is good, but know the measure so that you are not used up.
Holding firm to what is right helps. Pressing on brings danger. You can add to others without reducing yourself. Keeping your steadiness and dignity is a more valuable gift than giving up your self.
When three walk together, one must be reduced. When one walks alone, he finds a companion. Deep bonds form between two. The one who is extra is reduced, and the one who is alone finds a partner.
Reducing your own ailment. Acting quickly brings joy. No fault. When you drop your faults fast, people come near with gladness.

Someone adds to you with a precious tortoise shell worth ten strings of shells. It cannot be refused. Great good fortune. When you reduce yourself and receive with humility, good fortune comes with nothing able to stand in its way.

Adding to others without reducing yourself. No fault. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. It helps to go forward. You gain helpers who do not think of their own households. One who gives to the community without making anyone lose wins the loyalty of people everywhere.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Sometimes less is more. Today, try letting go of one excess in your life.

yearMessageEn.overview: Reducing in the right measure adds beauty. This year suits letting go of excess, living simply, calming emotions and giving for the common good. You will see that few things truly matter.
yearMessageEn.work: Drop some needless burdens and keep only what has real effect.
yearMessageEn.love: Lower unrealistic expectations of each other. Simple and sincere is enough.
yearMessageEn.money: Live simply and with enough. Cut excess without stress.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be content with what you have and light at heart.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Benefit. It helps to go forward. It helps to cross the great river.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind and thunder strengthen each other: the picture of benefit. The wise person therefore follows the good when they see it, and corrects themselves when they find a fault.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Those above lower themselves so that those below may flourish. This is a time of abundance, like wind and thunder that grow stronger by supporting each other. It is a good moment to undertake great matters and to cross hardship, for heaven opens the way. But such a time does not last, so use it well, both in helping others and in improving yourself.
linesEn: It helps to undertake a great work. Great good fortune. No fault. With support from above, use the chance to build something great, but do it fully well so that no fault follows.

Someone adds to you with a precious tortoise shell worth ten strings of shells. It cannot be refused. Holding firm to what is right for the long term brings good fortune. The king offers sacrifice to heaven. Good fortune. Luck that comes through humility is steady. Accept it with gratitude and honesty.
Benefit comes through bad events. No fault. With sincerity and the middle way, you carry a jade token to report to the lord. Even if gain comes through hardship, being open and sincere earns trust.
Walking the middle way, you report to the lord and he follows. It helps to be relied on when a city is moved. One who is impartial and trusted can be a bridge in a great change.
Sincere and kind of heart. No need to ask: great good fortune. People will sincerely repay your virtue. True kindness needs no confirmation, for its results show in people's hearts.

No one adds to you, and instead someone attacks. The heart is not steady. Danger. One who only takes without giving, and keeps changing their mind, will be abandoned, and people will turn against them.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Wind and thunder lift each other. When you see goodness in others, learn from it and pass it on.

yearMessageEn.overview: Wind and thunder strengthen each other. This year brings more benefit. When you receive, share. Improve yourself and use this golden time to bring your good intentions to fruition.
yearMessageEn.work: There is room to grow. Improve yourself and do the good you planned.
yearMessageEn.love: When you receive love, return it with care. Sharing makes it grow.
yearMessageEn.money: Good timing. Use it well and share a part with others.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you increase in both good things and kindness.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Resolution. It must be proclaimed openly at court. Cry out in sincerity that there is danger. Announce it to your own town. It does not help to use weapons, but it helps to go forward.
hexagrams.imageEn: The lake rises high above the sky: the picture of resolution. The wise person therefore shares rank and reward with those below and takes care not to sit alone on their virtue.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The force of what is right has grown nearly full, leaving just one dark line at the top. It is time to remove what is bad decisively, but openly and fairly, not with violence or anger. Show everyone the truth. Begin by preparing your own house, and do not be careless, for what is about to lose often struggles dangerously.
linesEn: Strength in the toes that step forward. Going, you do not win, and it becomes a fault. Rushing ahead without enough strength brings failure on yourself.
A cry of warning, with caution. Even if enemies come in the night, there is no need to worry. When you are prepared and always alert, a danger that comes unexpected cannot harm you.

Strength in the cheekbones. Danger. The wise person is decisive. Walking alone, he meets rain, gets soaked and is blamed, but there is no fault. Showing fury on the face is dangerous, but one with steady purpose, even if misunderstood for a time, is without fault.

The buttocks have no skin and he walks haltingly. If he lets others lead him like a sheep, regret fades, but hearing advice he does not believe it. Stubbornness leaves him unable to sit or walk with ease. If he will listen and follow those who know, he will be free of trouble.
Pulling out the weeds decisively. Walking the middle way brings no fault. What is bad and rooted near you must be pulled out completely, but with balance and fairness.
No cry of warning. In the end there is danger. When no one warns and you are not careful, the bad that remains leads to the end.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A truth spoken calmly has more power than anger. What do you need to say clearly today?

yearMessageEn.overview: Clouds gather until rain must fall. This year it is time to reveal the truth and decide firmly, but without violence. Mind the details and do not be careless, even when the goal is near.
yearMessageEn.work: Decide the matters left hanging. Speak the truth politely and with care.
yearMessageEn.love: Say what has been left unsaid, directly but gently. Do not be harsh.
yearMessageEn.money: Cut the unnecessary firmly, but check carefully first.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you dare to speak the truth and find a clear path.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Encounter. This woman has a strong and forceful nature. Do not marry her.
hexagrams.imageEn: Beneath the sky wind blows: the picture of encounter. The ruler therefore issues commands and proclaims teachings to the four directions.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The first dark line quietly appears beneath five bright ones, like a small thing that seems harmless but will grow until it takes over. A chance meeting brings both opportunity and risk. Do not get bound to what looks gentle but hides a force that eats away. Stop what is bad while it is still small, and let what is right spread everywhere, like wind blowing in every direction.
linesEn: Tied to a metal brake. Holding to what is right brings good fortune. If let go, it will meet danger, like a lean pig that looks weak but is ready to leap and struggle. Stop what is bad at the very start, for though it looks weak now, it will become a great problem.
A fish in the bag. No fault. But it does not help the guests. Once you have the matter under control in your hands, keep it and do not let it spread to others.
The buttocks have no skin and he walks haltingly. There is danger but no great fault. Hesitating to approach what tempts you, though uneasy, helps you escape a major mistake.
No fish in the bag. Acting brings danger. When you have grown distant from those below and no one supports you, any action will not succeed.

Wrapping the melon with wolfberry leaves. Hide its beauty within, and good things will fall from heaven. One who protects what is fragile with patience, and does not show off their virtue, will receive heaven's blessing at the right time.
Meeting with the horns. Shame, but no fault. Holding yourself high and harsh so that no one comes near may look proud, but it protects you from what is bad.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A small meeting can change direction. Today, notice what is coming into your life.

yearMessageEn.overview: A chance meeting may be the start of something big. This year, beware small influences taking shape. Stop them early if they do not suit you, and choose well whom you open your heart to.
yearMessageEn.work: Watch for people or small matters creeping in. Check well before taking them on.
yearMessageEn.love: A chance meeting has charm, but get to know each other before bonding deeply.
yearMessageEn.money: Beware offers that look too easy. Check them carefully.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you find fitting good things when you least expect them.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Gathering. Flourishing. The king comes to the ancestral temple. It helps to meet a great person. Flourishing. It helps when one holds firmly to what is right. A great sacrifice brings good fortune. It helps to go forward.
hexagrams.imageEn: The lake lies above the earth: the picture of gathering. The wise person therefore repairs weapons to be ready for the unexpected.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Water flows together into a lake on the land, and people assemble around a leader of virtue. This is a time to join strength. A lasting gathering needs a spiritual center, such as shared faith or a fair leader, and it is right to give fully to what matters. But when many people and much wealth come together, conflict arises easily, so always be ready for the unexpected.
linesEn: Sincere but not lasting, so confusion arises in the gathering. If you call out, a clasp of hands brings back a smile. Do not worry. Going on is without fault. Hesitation unsettles the heart, but if you open up and call to the true leader, sorrow turns into a smile.
Being drawn in brings good fortune. No fault. With sincerity, even a small offering helps. A gathering that arises from natural attraction and sincerity does not need elaborate ceremony.
Gathering with sighing. Nothing helps. Going on is without fault, but there is a little shame. When no group welcomes you, step toward the one that fits, even if you lose a little face.
Great good fortune. No fault. One who draws many people together while in a secondary position must act with real rightness to have good fortune and no fault.

Gathering while holding a position. No fault. If some still do not trust you, hold to great virtue for a long time. Regret fades. A leader with a post but not yet people's hearts must win them through steady virtue.
Sighing and weeping, tears streaming down the face. No fault. When the wish to join a group goes unfulfilled, sincere sorrow opens the way back to connection with others.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Water becomes a lake because there is a place to hold it. Today, who would you like to walk with?

yearMessageEn.overview: People gather through faith and a fair leader. This year suits joining forces, building a group you trust, and preparing for the unexpected, for a large gathering needs good care.
yearMessageEn.work: Bring the team together toward a shared goal. A fair leader matters most.
yearMessageEn.love: Gather family and friends. Bonds grow from being together.
yearMessageEn.money: Keep some reserve for the unexpected. Being ready is security.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your new year be full of people you love and trust.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Ascending. Supremely flourishing. Go and meet a great person. Do not worry. Traveling south brings good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: A tree grows up from within the earth: the picture of ascending. The wise person therefore follows virtue with humility, gathering small things until they become great.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: A seedling pushes its shoot up from the soil. It does not hurry, but grows a little every day without stopping. This is a time of steady progress. The road is open and elders stand ready to support you. Success comes from humility and steady perseverance, not from leaping over steps. Gather goodness bit by bit, and it will grow tall by itself.
linesEn: Rising with trust. Great good fortune. When those above accept you, growth is smooth.
With sincerity, even a small offering helps. No fault. Honesty matters more than ceremony or gifts.
Ascending into an empty city. The road ahead is open with nothing in the way. Go forward, but do not be careless.
The king makes an offering at Mount Qi. Good fortune. No fault. One who serves with loyalty and respect for what is sacred earns honor and security.
Holding to what is right brings good fortune. Ascending by steps. Growth that follows order and rightness will carry you steadily to the highest point.

Rising in the dark. It helps to hold to what is right without rest. Climbing blindly, never knowing when enough is enough, is dangerous. If you are to go on, turn to patient care for what is right instead of reaching for more.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A tree grows from under the ground bit by bit. Do not look down on the small steps you are taking.

yearMessageEn.overview: A tree sprouts from the soil and slowly rises. This year suits growing little by little, with perseverance and the support of elders, never standing still and never rushing past the steps.
yearMessageEn.work: Advance step by step with perseverance, and accept support from your seniors.
yearMessageEn.love: The relationship grows slowly and steadily. Do not rush beyond its pace.
yearMessageEn.money: Grow gradually. Plan in steps and keep at it.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you grow taller, one steady step at a time.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Hemmed in, yet still flourishing. Holding firmly to what is right, the great person has good fortune. No fault. There are words, but no one believes them.
hexagrams.imageEn: A lake without water: the picture of being hemmed in. The wise person therefore is willing to stake their life to fulfill their purpose.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The water of the lake seeps down and the lake runs dry, like a person pressed until they have no strength, and no one listens. Yet hardship is a test of the heart. One who holds to principle passes through and comes out stronger. At this time words carry no weight. Speak less, and let actions and patience be your proof. Do not let outer conditions destroy the calm within.
linesEn: The buttocks are pressed beneath a tree stump. He enters a dark valley and for three years sees no one. When discouraged until you sink into your own darkness, the suffering drags on. Do not give in to gloom.

Pressed by wine and food. The one in the red sash is arriving. It helps to make an offering. Pushing ahead brings danger, but no fault. Though the body is comfortable, the heart is unfulfilled. Wait for the one who will help, with a calm heart and faith. Do not hurry.
Pressed by stone, clinging to thorns. Returning home, he does not find his wife. Danger. Struggling the wrong way hurts more and loses even the support nearest to you.
Coming slowly, pressed by a golden cart. Shame, but it ends in success. Help comes late because wealth and power are in the way, but good intent will arrive in the end.
His nose and feet are cut. Pressed by the one in the red sash. Joy slowly returns. It helps to make an offering. Though pressed from above and below, calm and faith will slowly lead the way out.

Pressed by creepers, on a swaying, unsteady place. He tells himself that moving brings regret. If he repents, going forward brings good fortune. The bonds left are only fear in the heart. Once you see it, dare to step out.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Even if the lake dries up, the heart need not dry with it. You can always choose how to respond.

yearMessageEn.overview: Water dries up beneath the tree. You may feel blocked or surrounded this year, but holding to your ideals with an unyielding heart, you will get through. Speak less, as words may not be heard now.
yearMessageEn.work: In a stuck time, do not waste energy explaining. Do good work and wait.
yearMessageEn.love: Even if misunderstood, stay steady and stay together. Time will show the truth.
yearMessageEn.money: Be thrifty and careful. Use patience to pass through the lean time.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your heart never give up and always find a way out.

hexagrams.meaningEn: A well, a source of nourishment
hexagrams.judgmentEn: The well. A town may be moved but the well cannot. It neither empties nor fills. People come and go and draw from it without end. If the rope nearly reaches the water but not quite, and the jar breaks first, there is danger.
hexagrams.imageEn: Water above wood: the picture of the well. The wise person therefore encourages people in their work and urges them to help one another.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The well is a source of nourishment that never moves. Anyone may draw from it, and it never dries nor overflows, like true human nature and the virtue deep in the heart. Though the world outside changes, this remains. The trouble is usually not a lack of water, but keeping the well clean and drawing all the way to the water. Refine yourself until you are clear and clean, and carry your work through to the end. Do not stop halfway.
linesEn: The well is only mud and cannot be drunk from. An old well that not even birds visit. When you neglect yourself until you decay, no one comes to rely on you any more.

At the bottom of the well water seeps, good only for shooting small fish. The bucket is rotten and leaks. You have ability but spend it on trivial things, and lack the tool to bring it out to be useful.

The well has been cleared of silt, but no one drinks. It makes my heart sad. This water can be drawn. If the king is wise, all will receive blessing. A capable person not yet seen for their worth must wait for a leader who notices, so that their ability can be used.
The well is lined with bricks. No fault. A time of pausing your service to others to repair and refine yourself is the right kind of preparation.
The well is clear and clean, with cold spring water to drink. One with pure virtue who is ready to give becomes a true refuge who nourishes people.
The water is drawn up. Do not cover the well. With sincerity, great good fortune. When a source of nourishment is open to everyone equally and can be trusted, its value is complete.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: The well stays in its place and nourishes all who come to draw. What is your source of strength today?

yearMessageEn.overview: A well nourishes people without choosing, but it must be kept clean. This year, return to your true source, refine yourself and nourish others. See things through rather than doing them halfway.
yearMessageEn.work: Go back to the basics of your work. Sharpen your skills and see it through.
yearMessageEn.love: Nourish the relationship with small, steady acts of care.
yearMessageEn.money: Look after your income sources and foundations well. They sustain you.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be a well of kindness that never runs dry.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: When the day is ripe, people come to believe in the change. Great and flourishing. It favors staying steady on the right path. Regret fades away.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire within the lake: water and fire overcome each other, and so change arises. The wise person therefore sets the calendar in order and makes the seasons clear.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: What has outlived its time must be shed, as an animal sheds its coat with the season. But change succeeds only when the time is ripe and people agree and trust it. Rushing ahead too early brings resistance and damage. Examine the reasons for change again and again, and act with a pure heart, not for your own gain. Then the reform will be accepted and will last.
linesEn: Bound with the hide of a yellow ox. It is not yet time to change. Hold to the middle way and wait patiently until conditions are ready.
When the day is ripe, then act to change. Going forward brings good fortune, and there is no fault. The time is ready, and change made at the right moment will be supported.

Pressing ahead brings danger, and holding stubbornly is also perilous. When talk of change has been weighed three times, it earns trust. Do not rush and do not stand still. Listen and review until all sides agree.
Regret fades away. Sincerity is trusted, so the mandate can be changed. Good fortune. A great change succeeds when it rests on honesty that people can see.
The great person changes like a tiger's stripes. Before any divining, he is already trusted. A true leader changes with dignity and clarity, so that people believe without needing proof.

The wise person changes like a leopard's spots, while the petty person only changes his expression. Pushing on brings danger, and staying steady brings good fortune. Once the great change is done, stop and tidy the details. Do not keep changing without end.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Good change waits for its time. Today, what in your life is ready to shed its leaves?

yearMessageEn.overview: Flame and lake transform each other. This is a season for renewal and adjustment, but change when the time is right, with credibility, and explain your reasons to those involved.
yearMessageEn.work: Change how you work when the time comes. Explain why, so your team trusts you.
yearMessageEn.love: Change in a relationship needs conversation. Do not decide alone.
yearMessageEn.money: Adjust financial plans when things change, but do it carefully.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your changes be graceful and lasting.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: The three-legged cauldron. Great good fortune. Flourishing.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire burning above wood: the picture of the cauldron cooking. The wise person therefore takes the proper position and makes the mandate of life firm and steady.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The three-legged cauldron is a sacred vessel used to cook offerings for the spirits and to feed the wise. It stands for nourishing what is valuable: body, spirit and the order of society. After a change, the new must be cultivated until it ripens and takes firm hold. Take your proper place, stay steady, and use your abilities to feed others. Then good fortune will come on its own.
linesEn: The cauldron is turned over with its legs up, which helps to pour out the waste. He takes a concubine for the sake of her son. No fault. What looks like an upset actually clears out the old. Even a humble position can create value.
There is food in the cauldron. My rivals are envious but cannot harm me. Good fortune. When there is substance within, the envy of others cannot reach it.

The handles of the cauldron are changed, so it cannot be lifted. The fine pheasant meat is eaten by no one. When rain falls, regret fades. In the end, good fortune. You have ability but no one yet sees its worth. Wait patiently, and one day the tension will ease.

The legs of the cauldron break, and the master's meal is spilled. His body is soiled. Danger. Carrying a burden beyond your strength, or trusting the wrong person, ruins great work and damages your name.
The cauldron has yellow handles and golden carrying rings. It favors staying steady on the right path. Someone in a high position who is humble and open to advice draws capable people to help.
The cauldron has jade carrying rings. Great good fortune. Nothing is unfavorable. Strength joined with gentleness, like jade, brings complete success.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A cauldron turns raw ingredients into a meal. What would you like to nurture until it ripens today?

yearMessageEn.overview: The three-legged cauldron stands firm and nourishes everyone. This year suits cultivating people and what is valuable, holding your proper place, and preparing good things that nourish others too.
yearMessageEn.work: Hold firm in your role and help your team grow. Build what will last.
yearMessageEn.love: Nurture love like cooking a meal, with time and care.
yearMessageEn.money: Allocate with balance. Use resources for what truly nourishes growth.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you stand firm and nourish the good around you.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Flourishing. When thunder comes, people are startled, and then they laugh and talk cheerfully. Thunder shakes for a hundred li, yet the one performing the rite does not drop the ladle or the offering wine.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder upon thunder, one peal after another. The wise person therefore feels reverence and fear, then refines themselves and examines their conduct.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Sudden events shake life like a thunderbolt and frighten us. Yet that alarm wakes us up and makes us careful. One whose heart is steady loses nothing that matters, even when the world outside is in turmoil. When it has passed, we can laugh again. Use the shock as a chance to reflect on yourself, and do not let it take over your mind.
linesEn: When thunder comes, people are startled, and afterward they laugh and talk cheerfully. Good fortune. The first fright leads to care and ends in relief.

Thunder comes with danger. Much property is lost. Climb up to the nine hills and do not chase what was lost. Within seven days it will return. In a crisis, protect yourself first. What was lost will come back by itself in time.
Thunder leaves one bewildered and confused. If the alarm spurs you to act and put things right, there will be no harm. Turn fright into driving energy instead of standing still without direction.
Thunder sinks into the mud. The force that should awaken is stuck in the mire. The surroundings hold you back, and nothing you do has any effect.

Thunder goes and returns. Danger, but nothing is lost. There is still a task to carry out. Even if the shocks come again and again, if you hold to your own center you can still do your duty completely.

Thunder leaves one trembling, eyes darting. Pressing ahead is dangerous. If the thunder has not reached you but has reached your neighbor, take care in advance and there will be no fault, though those close to you may gossip. When you see harm befall others, step back and prepare early, even if you are thought timid.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Thunder wakes us and then passes. When something startles you, take a deep breath before you react.

yearMessageEn.overview: Thunder wakes us up. It is a shock, but also a chance to grow stronger inside. Something may shake you this year. Steady yourself, stay wisely respectful and calm. Thunder passes, and calm returns.
yearMessageEn.work: The unexpected may happen. Stay steady and keep doing the right thing.
yearMessageEn.love: Feelings may waver. Breathe deeply and talk once you are calm.
yearMessageEn.money: If something shakes you, do not make financial decisions in a panic.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your heart stay still, even on days of thunder.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Keep still at the back, until the self is no longer felt. Walk in the courtyard and see no one. No fault.
hexagrams.imageEn: Mountain upon mountain: the picture of stillness. The wise person therefore does not let their thoughts wander beyond their own position.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The mountain stands unmoved. It teaches us to stop when it is time to stop and to move when it is time to move. True stillness is not holding yourself down. It is a mind so calm that neither the self nor outside stimulation pulls it away. Now is a good time for meditation, reflection, and staying within the limits of your duties. Do not let your thoughts run beyond your strength or station.
linesEn: Keeping the toes still. No fault. It favors lasting steadiness. Stopping at the very first step, before an error, means no harm is done.
Keeping the calves still, but unable to help the one he follows. His heart is not at ease. He knows he should stop, but is carried along by others and cannot hold back, so he feels uneasy.
Keeping the hips still, so that the spine is nearly torn. Danger scorches the heart. Forcing yourself rigidly to be still goes against nature and brings suffering and pressure to the mind.
Keeping the torso still. No fault. The self begins to grow quiet. Though not yet complete, it is practice on the right path.
Keeping the jaw still, so that words come in order. Regret fades away. When you guard your speech and speak at the right time and in good order, you will not regret it later.
Keeping still with firm steadiness. Good fortune. Calm that is complete from within is the height of stillness and brings true happiness.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A mountain is still without effort. Today, pause a moment and notice where it is time to say: this is enough.

yearMessageEn.overview: The mountain stops and stands firm. This year suits pausing to see clearly, knowing your limits, and practicing meditation. When the mind is still, your actions land at the right place and time.
yearMessageEn.work: Know the limits of your job and focus on one thing until it is done well.
yearMessageEn.love: A still mind listens more deeply. There is no need to fill every silence.
yearMessageEn.money: Know your spending limits and stop before going beyond your means.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you be steady and calm like a mountain.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: A young woman marries by the proper steps. Good fortune. It favors staying steady on the right path.
hexagrams.imageEn: A tree grows upon the mountain. The wise person therefore holds to excellent virtue in order to improve the customs of the people.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: A tree on a mountain grows slowly but roots firmly, like wild geese that land one stage at a time. Lasting growth must follow its steps. It cannot be hurried or skipped, just as a marriage must go through every step properly. Be patient and slowly build influence through virtue. The result will be steady and accepted.
linesEn: The wild goose slowly settles on the shore. The young man is in danger and there is gossip, but no fault. Beginnings are fragile and criticized. Step carefully and no harm is done.
The wild goose slowly settles on a rock. It eats and drinks in comfort and joy. Good fortune. You have found firm ground. Share your abundance with others, gladly.

The wild goose slowly settles on the high plain. The husband goes away and does not return. The wife is with child but does not give birth. Danger, but it favors defending against robbers. Pushing out beyond your limits brings damage. Stay on the defensive and protect what you have.
The wild goose slowly settles in a tree. Perhaps it finds a flat branch to rest on. No fault. You are in a place that does not suit you, but if you adapt and find shelter humbly, you are safe.

The wild goose slowly settles on the hilltop. The wife has no child for three years, but in the end nothing can stop her. Good fortune. Even if a relationship or work is blocked and delayed, honesty wins in the end.
The wild goose slowly rises into the great sky. Its feathers can be used as ornament in ceremony. Good fortune. One who has gone beyond worldly tasks can still be a fine example to others.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A tree on a mountain grows slowly but steadily. What matters most need not be rushed to the finish.

yearMessageEn.overview: A tree on a mountain grows one step at a time. This year, gradual progress is the right way. Be patient and do not skip steps, especially in relationships, which need ceremony and time.
yearMessageEn.work: Move forward one step at a time. Do not skip the steps that should be done.
yearMessageEn.love: Good love moves in order. Do not rush it. Let time help.
yearMessageEn.money: Build security step by step. Plan in stages and keep at it.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you advance steadily, one step at a time.

hexagrams.meaningEn: A young bride of lesser rank
hexagrams.judgmentEn: A young woman goes to be married. Pushing ahead is dangerous. Nothing is favorable.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder above the lake. The wise person therefore looks to what will last to the very end and sees clearly what will decay.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: A younger sister who marries as a secondary wife must live in a place she did not choose. A relationship that begins from a passing impulse or from unequal standing is often fragile. Pressing ahead or making demands brings bad results. Know your standing, conduct yourself quietly and modestly, and look at the relationship in the long term, instead of clinging to what pleases you for the moment.
linesEn: A young woman marries as a secondary wife, like a lame person who can still walk. Going forward brings good fortune. Even in a lesser position, if you do your duty humbly and faithfully, you can still be of use.
Like a one-eyed person who can still see. It favors the steadiness of one who lives in solitude. Even if ignored or disappointed in a partner, keep your loyalty and virtue, quietly and gracefully.

A young woman goes to marry as one who waits and serves, and then returns as a secondary wife. Ambition beyond her station means no one accepts her, and in the end she must accept a lower place than before.
The young woman delays her wedding day. A marriage that is late has its proper time. She does not lower her worth for convenience. Waiting for what is right will bear fruit at the right time.

The sovereign Di Yi gives his daughter in marriage. The princess's robes are not as splendid as those of the secondary wife. The moon is nearly full. Good fortune. A noble person who is humble and does not show off has a complete inner beauty.
A woman holds a basket with no fruit in it. A man slaughters a sheep but there is no blood. Nothing is favorable. A rite that is only an outer shell, without sincerity, produces no result.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Sometimes we are not in the position we hoped for. Knowing your place can make the heart lighter.

yearMessageEn.overview: Be careful of relationships that do not suit your standing or timing. This year, know your place, do not rush what is not ready, and look closely at what can truly last.
yearMessageEn.work: Know your role. Do not overreach or step into others' areas.
yearMessageEn.love: Be clear whether this relationship can last before committing deeply.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend according to your real situation. Do not compare or rush.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you find what is right and truly lasting.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Abundance. Flourishing. A king reaches this state. Do not worry. Be like the sun at noon.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder and lightning come together: the picture of abundance. The wise person therefore decides cases and applies penalties decisively.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: This is a time of plenty and power at its peak, like the sun at midday. But a sun at its zenith begins to sink, so prosperity does not last. Do not worry about the decline to come. Use this time to shine on everyone with clarity and decisiveness. Beware of what hides the truth and of those who flatter.
linesEn: He meets a leader who is his match. Even staying together ten days is no fault. Going forward will be honored. Abilities that complement each other create prosperity when they work together.

The screen is so thick that the Dipper can be seen at noon. If you press ahead you will be met with suspicion, but if you rouse him with sincerity, it brings good fortune. When a leader is clouded and blind, do not force things. Let sincerity gradually help him to see.
The thicket is so dense that tiny stars can be seen at noon. His right arm is broken, but no fault. Darkness blocks you so that you cannot act. Even if you must stop, it is not your own fault.
The screen is so thick that the Dipper can be seen at noon, but he meets a leader of like mind. Good fortune. In dark times, meeting someone who shares your ideals will lead you out into the light.
He draws capable people in. There is both joy and fame. Good fortune. A humble leader who welcomes talent gains honor, and prosperity is shared.

A grand and spacious house, but a screen is drawn across it. Looking through the door, it is silent and empty of people. For three years no one is seen. Danger. Pride in wealth leaves you isolated and cut off from people, with only emptiness left.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: The midday sun will soon begin to sink. When all is thriving, use this time with clear eyes.

yearMessageEn.overview: Abundance is like the midday sun. This year everything may be bright and plentiful, but know that prosperity does not last. Use the good time wisely and prepare your heart too.
yearMessageEn.work: Your work shines. Use this time for what matters and do not be careless.
yearMessageEn.love: A bright time for the relationship. Enjoy the happiness and give thanks fully.
yearMessageEn.money: There is plenty. Use it wisely and keep reserves for times of change.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your new year be bright and full of joy.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: The traveler flourishes in small matters. Staying steady on the right path brings the traveler good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire burning upon the mountain: the picture of the traveler. The wise person therefore applies penalties clearly and with care, and lets no case linger unsettled.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Fire on a mountain spreads on and does not stay in one place, like a traveler in a strange land with no home to rest in. In such a situation, be courteous, humble and careful. Do not show off or get involved in petty matters. Choose your lodging and your company well. Success comes in small things if you keep your honesty.
linesEn: The traveler fusses over trivial matters and so brings trouble upon himself. In a strange place, narrow-mindedness and lowering yourself without dignity bring contempt and problems.
The traveler reaches his lodging. He has money with him and gains a faithful young servant. When you conduct yourself calmly and courteously, you find shelter, resources and a helper you can trust.
The traveler burns down his lodging and loses his servant. Pressing on is dangerous. Pride and harshness toward others in a foreign land cost him every place of refuge.

The traveler finds temporary lodging. He gains money and an ax to defend himself, but his heart is not at ease. He has enough to get by, but it is not yet his true place, so he feels wary and unsettled.

He shoots a pheasant and loses one arrow. In the end he receives praise and a post. Be willing to give up a little to show your ability at the right moment, and even in a foreign place you will be accepted.

The bird burns its own nest. The traveler laughs first and then weeps. He loses his ox through carelessness. Danger. Arrogance and carelessness lose him his shelter and what matters. Brief joy turns to sorrow.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A traveler carries only what is needed and is courteous to people. Today, what no longer needs to be carried?

yearMessageEn.overview: A traveler must be courteous and careful. This year may bring travel or a change of place, a new home, new faces. Keep goodwill, do not ask too much, and remember you are a guest in a new place.
yearMessageEn.work: In a new setting, be courteous, observe, and do the small things well first.
yearMessageEn.love: A distant or new relationship needs courtesy and steady communication.
yearMessageEn.money: Watch your spending when you travel and keep valuables secure.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your journey be safe, with friends all along the way.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Gentleness flourishes in small matters. It favors having a direction to go. It favors meeting the great person.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind follows wind, one after another. The wise person therefore repeats the command so that it is clear, and then carries out the work.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Wind has no shape yet slips into every corner. Gentle but steady influence therefore changes things more deeply than force. Have a clear goal, persuade slowly and persistently, and seek a wise leader as your adviser. But take care that gentleness does not turn into hesitation and indecision.
linesEn: Advancing and then retreating. It favors the firm steadiness of a warrior. Wavering back and forth must be cured by the discipline and resolve of the brave.
Creeping in under the bed, using many diviners and shamans. Good fortune. No fault. You must trace hidden influences to their source and bring them out into the open.
Creeping in again and again. Shameful. Going round and round in thought and refusing to decide lose opportunities and bring disgrace.
Regret fades away. On the hunt he catches three kinds of game. Humility joined with eagerness makes work succeed and brings benefit in many ways.

Staying steady on the right path brings good fortune. Regret fades away. Nothing is unfavorable. There is no good beginning but there is a good ending. Three days before the change and three days after: good fortune. Correcting what went wrong needs thought before acting, and careful follow-up afterward.
Creeping in under the bed, he loses his money and his ax. Pressing on is dangerous. Searching too far, or yielding until your strength is gone, loses the tools that protect you.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Wind is gentle yet reaches everywhere. Steady gentleness can change things.

yearMessageEn.overview: Wind gets through because it is gentle and continuous. This year, soft persuasion is stronger than force. Repeat steadily and listen for a clear direction, and your influence will spread.
yearMessageEn.work: Use gentle, steady persuasion instead of orders or pressure.
yearMessageEn.love: Steady gentleness sinks deeper than sweet words. Do it slowly, from the heart.
yearMessageEn.money: Change money habits a little at a time, steadily. No need to rush.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your gentleness reach into people's hearts.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Joy. Flourishing. It favors staying steady on the right path.
hexagrams.imageEn: Two lakes joined together: the picture of joy. The wise person therefore gathers with friends to talk and study together.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Two lakes feed each other so neither runs dry, like the happiness that comes from sharing and learning together. True joy must rest on sincerity and inner steadiness, and be shown with gentleness, not shallow fun or flattery to please. Beware of pleasure that lures you off the path.
linesEn: Joy that is calm and harmonious. Good fortune. Happiness that does not depend on outside things and asks nothing is pure and steady.
Joy that comes from sincerity. Good fortune. Regret fades away. Even amid temptations, if the heart is honest, you will not go astray.
Joy sought from outside. Danger. Chasing fun and satisfaction with no principle in your heart leads to decline.

Weighing joys until the mind is unsettled. If you can cut yourself off from what leads to decline, there will be gladness. When torn between a higher and a lower pleasure, choose what is right, decisively.
Trusting what corrodes. Danger. Even someone in a high position can be led astray by a destructive influence. Be wary of those who approach with sweet words.
Joy that is lured out by others. One who is fascinated by pleasure and pulled along by temptation loses self-control.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: True gladness comes from a sincere heart. Today, try talking openly with a friend.

yearMessageEn.overview: Two lakes support each other. This year, joy, friendship and honest communication are your strength. Beware of empty sweet words, and let your happiness rest on honesty.
yearMessageEn.work: Communicate openly and cheerfully. Build a good atmosphere for working together.
yearMessageEn.love: Laugh and talk often, but let sincerity stand behind the words.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend on happiness and friends in moderation. Beware offers that sound too good.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your new year be full of smiles and true friends.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Dispersing. Flourishing. The king goes to the ancestral temple. It favors crossing the great river. It favors staying steady on the right path.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind blows over water, melting the ice and scattering what has set. The kings of old therefore made offerings to Heaven and built the ancestral temple.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Wind passing over water melts what has frozen and sends it scattering. What divides people, such as selfishness, rigidity and prejudice, must be dissolved, and then hearts unite around something higher than the self, like a ceremony that makes people one. This is a time to let go of clinging and to use shared faith to cross a great obstacle.
linesEn: Lending a hand with the strength of a sturdy horse. Good fortune. When a split has only just begun, deal with it firmly before it spreads.
In the scattering, hurry to a support. Regret fades away. When you feel estranged, return to the anchor in your heart or to someone you can rely on.
Dissolving attachment to the self. No regret. Setting selfishness aside for a larger goal means you have nothing to regret.

Dispersing his own faction. Great good fortune. The scattering leads to a great gathering, like a hill, which ordinary people would not imagine. Giving up small cliques for the common good builds a unity greater than before.

A great royal command goes out and spreads like sweat pouring forth. He distributes the stores of the royal treasury. No fault. In a time of division, a leader needs a clear idea to rally hearts, and must share what there is widely.
Dispersing the blood of quarrels. Go far away and leave the danger. No fault. Withdrawing from danger to protect yourself and those you love is the right thing.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Wind passes over water and the ice melts. Whatever in your heart has gone rigid, let it soften today.

yearMessageEn.overview: Wind blows over water and breaks the ice. This year suits dissolving rigidity, letting go of clinging, and uniting hearts through faith. What was apart will begin to flow together again.
yearMessageEn.work: Release strictness or conflict in the team and unite around a shared goal.
yearMessageEn.love: Let go of resentment, and hearts will flow back toward each other.
yearMessageEn.money: Ease the tension around money and handle the flow in an orderly way.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your tension melt and hearts come together again.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Moderation. Flourishing. But a limit that is too bitter should not be held to permanently.
hexagrams.imageEn: Water above the lake. The lake holds water within limits. The wise person therefore fixes numbers and measures, and examines virtue and conduct.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: A lake holds only as much as its size, and what exceeds it overflows. Life too needs limits in spending, in words and in emotions, like the joints of bamboo that make the stalk strong. But restraint so strict that it is bitter goes against nature and cannot last. Find a balance that feels comfortable, and you will be an example to others.
linesEn: Not going out of the inner door and courtyard. No fault. When the time is not right, knowing how to stay within limits and guard your words is wisdom.
Not going out of the outer door and courtyard. Danger. When the opportunity has come and you still do nothing, restricting yourself too much makes you miss the crucial moment.
One who does not know moderation will have cause to lament. No one is to blame but oneself. Indulging beyond limits brings suffering. If you realize this, it can still be mended.
Moderation that is calm and easy. Flourishing. When limits become second nature and need no force, success comes without wasted effort.
Moderation that is sweet. Good fortune. Going forward will be honored. A leader who sets limits on their own conduct before asking it of others makes people glad to follow.
Moderation that is bitter. Pressing on is dangerous, but regret fades away. Extreme strictness cannot last. It may sometimes be needed to keep what is right, but it should not become a permanent way.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Bamboo is strong because it has joints. Fitting limits help life go on for a long time.

yearMessageEn.overview: Bamboo has joints at fitting intervals. This year, knowing your limits is freedom. Keep discipline without being too strict, because rules that are too bitter cannot be borne long.
yearMessageEn.work: Set fitting limits and discipline, not so loose or so tight you cannot continue.
yearMessageEn.love: Balance in the relationship. Keep space and rules both sides can live with.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend and save in moderation. A discipline you can keep beats a plan too strict.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your life be balanced, with graceful limits and freedom.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Sincerity from within reaches even pigs and fish. Good fortune. It favors crossing the great river. It favors staying steady on the right path.
hexagrams.imageEn: Wind above the lake, stirring the surface of the water. The wise person therefore examines legal cases thoroughly and eases the death penalty.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Wind blows over a lake, and the water moves with it, though the wind itself cannot be seen. True sincerity has the power to reach even those hard to communicate with, like pigs and fish that have no understanding. In the lines of this symbol, the two yin lines in the middle are like a heart empty of prejudice, enclosed by firm yang lines. Listen with an open mind and understand others from their side, and trust will carry you across great obstacles.
linesEn: Being steadily prepared. Good fortune. If the heart leans elsewhere, there will be no peace. Sincerity must be firm from the start. If the mind wanders and secretly relies on others, calm is lost.
A crane calls from the shade, and its young answer. I have a fine cup of wine and will share it with you. Deep sincerity does not need to be announced. Those of like heart will answer on their own.
He finds a rival or a partner. One beats the drum, one stops, one weeps, one sings. One who leaves his joys and sorrows in the hands of others has moods that rise and fall with them, with no anchor.
The moon is nearly full. One of a pair of horses is lost. No fault. When near completion, being willing to leave your companions to strive toward something higher is no mistake.
He has a sincerity that binds everyone together. No fault. A leader whose truthfulness is the center can bind people's hearts closely.
The crowing of the rooster rises to the sky. Pressing on is dangerous. A rooster cannot fly up to the sky. Boasting beyond the truth, with empty confidence behind it, brings decline.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: An empty and sincere heart reaches others even without words. Today, try being sincere with yourself first.

yearMessageEn.overview: Wind over a lake touches the water without force. This year, sincerity and a mind free of prejudice are power. Trust that comes from within will reach others, even without much explanation.
yearMessageEn.work: Work with sincerity and transparency. Trust builds lasting results.
yearMessageEn.love: Be honest with your own heart and each other. Trust is built by consistency.
yearMessageEn.money: Be honest and transparent about money. Trust is valuable capital.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your heart be sincere and find deep trust.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: A slight excess. Flourishing. It favors staying steady on the right path. Small matters can be done, but great matters should not be. A bird in flight leaves behind only its call. It should not fly up high but should come down low. Great good fortune.
hexagrams.imageEn: Thunder upon the mountain. The wise person therefore is humble beyond the usual, mourns with sorrow beyond the usual, and spends thriftily beyond the usual.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Thunder on a mountain is loud but does not travel far. This is a time of little strength, so only small things can be done, and it is unwise to be ambitious in large ones, like a bird that should fly low and return to its nest rather than force itself high. Go beyond the usual in humility, thrift and care, instead of going too far in pride or extravagance.
linesEn: A bird that flies up before its time meets misfortune. Impatience that soars before you are ready leads to a mistake that cannot be put right.
Passing by the grandfather and meeting the grandmother. Not reaching the ruler and meeting the minister. No fault. Not overstepping the ranks, and humbly accepting the lower path, is no fault.
If you do not take extra precautions, someone may follow and do harm. Danger. Do not be careless because you think you are right. An unexpected enemy may strike from behind.

No fault. He does not overstep, and meets it just right. Pressing on is dangerous, so be careful. Do not hold stubbornly to your course forever. Know how to hold back, do not force an advance, and adapt to the situation.

Dense clouds but no rain, coming from the western outskirts. The prince shoots with a corded arrow and takes a creature in its cave. You have ability but cannot yet do great things. Find the hidden capable people and bring them in to work with you.

Not meeting him, but passing beyond. The bird flies away and is caught in the net. Danger. This is called calamity and disaster. Soaring beyond bounds without knowing when to stop brings a disaster of your own making.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: A small bird should not fly beyond its strength. Today, care for small things and leave the big ones.

yearMessageEn.overview: A bird flying low is safe. This year small matters go well but great ones need care. Be humble, stay low and mind the details. A slight excess in courtesy is better than excess in arrogance.
yearMessageEn.work: Focus on small things you do well. Avoid big tasks beyond your strength.
yearMessageEn.love: Care for each other's small things. Humility brings hearts close.
yearMessageEn.money: Spend carefully, with small necessities before big things.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you live humbly, full of small joys.

hexagrams.judgmentEn: Already across. Flourishing in small matters. It favors staying steady on the right path. The beginning brings good fortune, but the end will be confusion and disorder.
hexagrams.imageEn: Water above fire: the picture of what is already done. The wise person therefore thinks of the troubles that may arise and guards against them early.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: Every line is in its right position, like water over fire that cooks the food just right. This is the point of balance in success. But completeness is fragile. If the water boils over, it puts out the fire, and if the fire is strong, the water dries up. When everything has fallen into place, people tend to become careless, and disorder follows. Keep your success with attention to detail and prepare for trouble before it arrives.
linesEn: He holds back the wheels of the cart. His tail gets wet. No fault. When everyone is rushing forward, knowing how to slow yourself, even at a small loss, is no mistake.

The woman loses the curtain of her carriage. Do not chase it. Within seven days it will be found. When you are not recognized, do not struggle to seek it. What is yours will come back by itself in time.
King Gaozong attacked the land of Guifang and took three years to conquer it. Do not use petty people. Following up on a success takes long effort, and you must choose only people of virtue.
Fine clothes turn into rags. Be on guard all day. Even in prosperous times, always keep rags ready to stop the leaks, and do not be careless even for a moment.

The neighbor to the east slaughters an ox for the offering, which is not as good as the small offering of the neighbor to the west, who truly receives the blessing. Sincerity in small things is worth more than grand ritual without heart.
His head gets wet. Danger. One who has crossed but looks back, or plunges on out of overconfidence, will sink into the deep water.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Even after crossing the water safely, stay careful. What is done must be tended to last.

yearMessageEn.overview: Water over fire is already done, but success must be kept. This year, guard ahead of time, do not be careless, and check small things before they become big problems. Even good things need care.
yearMessageEn.work: Keep the work you have done well. Check small weak points before problems arise.
yearMessageEn.love: Do not assume a good relationship will stay good by itself. Give daily care.
yearMessageEn.money: Keep the stability you have. Guard ahead and do not be careless.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May your success be steady and lasting.

hexagrams.meaningEn: Not yet done, not yet crossed
hexagrams.judgmentEn: Not yet across. Flourishing. The little fox has almost crossed the river, but his tail gets wet. Nothing is favorable.
hexagrams.imageEn: Fire above water, each going its own way. The wise person therefore examines things carefully and sorts them, so that each is in its proper place.
hexagrams.descriptionEn: The final symbol of the I Ching is not an ending but a new beginning. Every line is still in the wrong position, yet each has a partner that answers it, so order is possible, like the spring that is about to arrive. The situation is near success but still needs great care, like the little fox so eager that his tail gets wet at the very end. Think it through, set everything in its place, and go on with hope.
linesEn: His tail gets wet. Shameful. Rushing before understanding the situation leads to error from the very start.
He holds back the wheels of the cart. Staying steady on the right path brings good fortune. It is not yet time to act. Be patient and gather strength, without giving up the goal.

Not yet across. Pressing ahead is dangerous, but it favors crossing the great river. Your own strength alone is not enough to break through, but if you change the situation by finding helpers or a new path, you will get across.

Staying steady on the right path brings good fortune. Regret fades away. He uses a force like thunder to subdue Guifang, and after three years is rewarded by the great state. It is time to fight with full strength to make the transition. Long effort will be rewarded.

Staying steady on the right path brings good fortune. No regret. The radiance of the wise person shines with sincerity. Good fortune. Victory has come. A light that comes from true virtue shines for people to see and believe.

Drinking wine in confidence in what is to come. No fault. But if he drinks until drunk and his head gets wet, that confidence loses its rightness. Celebrating while waiting for a new time is good, but indulging beyond limits ruins everything.
hexagrams.dailyMessageEn: Before the shore, the little fox must be most careful. It is not far now. Step steadily, little by little.

yearMessageEn.overview: The young fox is about to cross the river. This year you are close but not at the end. Be careful, not hasty, prepare for the transition, and keep hope. The time before success is a key one.
yearMessageEn.work: Nearly there. Be careful in the final stretch and do not rush into a mistake.
yearMessageEn.love: The relationship is moving to a new stage. Be patient and give each other hope.
yearMessageEn.money: Not at the target yet, but close. Keep discipline and do not tire early.
yearMessageEn.blessing: May you cross to the shore you hope for, with care.
